# dsh-plugin-pwsh7

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-pwsh7.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-pwsh7)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-pwsh7.svg)](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7/blob/main/LICENSE)

Windows DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that routes the model-facing **`pwsh` tool to PowerShell 7**
(`pwsh.exe`, major version >= 7) instead of falling back to Windows PowerShell 5.1.

- The executor inherits every behavior of the stock `dsh-pwsh-sandbox` executor: sandbox modes,
  `sandbox_permissions` escalation, denial/runner-failure facts, background jobs, output caps, and
  exit markers. It only replaces executable resolution.
- When PowerShell 7 is missing, a model-facing **`shell_router`** tool reports status, diagnoses
  sandbox problems, runs a self-check, switches routing, and removes the plugin-managed copy.
- **Installation is never automatic and is never started by the model.** When PowerShell 7 is
  missing, the Web GUI opens a setup dialog; installation only happens when the user clicks the
  install action there or in **Settings → PowerShell 7**, or when the user installs PowerShell 7
  manually.
- A **PowerShell 7 settings page** in the Web GUI shows the resolved executable, version, install
  directory, scope and method, optionally **self-checks** the whole routing stack, **switches
  routing** back to the system default, **uninstalls** a plugin-managed per-user install, and
  **migrates** a per-user install to the system scope.
- In the Web GUI, a **setup dialog** opens whenever PowerShell 7 is missing — on load and again on
  every `pwsh` run — with a download button and live progress (bytes, percent, phase). Closing it
  never cancels an install, and the next failed run re-opens it.

English | [中文说明](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7/blob/main/README.zh.md)

---

## Why

On Windows, DSH mounts `pwsh-sandbox` as `ctx.shell`, but the resolved executable can end up being
Windows PowerShell 5.1 in some environments. This bundle keeps the stock PowerShell executor and
overrides only its `pwshPath` resolution:

1. **Take over the `pwsh-sandbox` slot**: a DSH patch entry's `name` asserts the targeted row, it
   does not replace it, so the stock row is disabled by id and a `RouterPwshExecutor extends
   SandboxPwshExecutor` row (`id: pwsh7-executor`) is inserted. An explicit `config.pwshPath` still
   wins; otherwise the plugin-resolved PowerShell 7 is used.
2. **Insert the bare `dsh-plugin-pwsh7` row**, which registers the `shell_router` tool
   (`status` / `diagnose` / `selfcheck` / `route` / `uninstall`), a small system-prompt section, the
   setup dialog/settings routes, and the browser bundle.
   That row's name is also what DSH's client-module scanner uses to discover `client.js`; the
   executor row's `./pwsh-executor` subpath is not a client-bundle source.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11.
- A DSH profile that supports bundles (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` / Web profile). Tested against
  DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2.
- Node.js >= 22 is only needed to run the repository test suite.

## Installation

Install from npm through the DSH plugin manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=dsh-plugin-pwsh7@0.3.2
```

Or install from a local checkout (a directory install links the checkout, which is convenient while
developing):

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-pwsh7
```

The new bundle is applied through HMR immediately. After changing the plugin's source, restart DSH
to load a fresh module generation.

## Usage

The model-facing `shell_router` tool:

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| `status` (default) | Resolved PowerShell 7 path and version, config file, current sandbox policy, shipped-package resolution. |
| `diagnose` | Runs real PowerShell 7 commands under the **current sandbox policy** (version + workspace write) and reports exit codes, stdout/stderr, denial/runner-failure classification, and concrete hints. |
| `install`, `relocate` | **Not performed by the tool.** They return guidance: installation is user-initiated only, from the setup dialog, Settings → PowerShell 7, or a manual install. |
| `selfcheck` | Runs the same read-only self-check as the settings page and returns `ok` / `warn` / `fail` lines. |
| `route` | Persists `route: "plugin"` or `route: "system"` and reports the new route. |
| `uninstall` | Removes the plugin-managed per-user portable install (files, temporary directory, managed PATH entry) while keeping the routing preference. |

### Model guidance (PowerShell 7 dialect)

Prompt injection is **opt-in and off by default** (upgrading never starts spending prompt tokens).
Two levels are available in the **setup dialog** (when PowerShell 7 is missing) and in
**Settings → PowerShell 7 → Prompt guidance**; the choice is stored as `dialect` in `config.json` and
takes effect on the next model step without a restart.

| Level | What it adds | Cost per request |
|---|---|---|
| Common guidance | States that `pwsh` is PowerShell 7 (not bash, not cmd), lists the bash-only forms that fail beside their PowerShell replacements (`export`, `[[ ]]`, heredoc, `source`, `$(...)`, `for … do`, POSIX tools), and tells the model to rewrite after a parser error. | 1,337 chars ≈ 335 tokens |
| Force PowerShell 7 mode | Adds: substitute the PowerShell equivalent even when the request names a POSIX tool. Requires the common level (checking it also checks common). | 1,442 chars ≈ 361 tokens |

Measured on 12 bash-inviting tasks with 5 samples each (see `docs/dialect-ab.md`): 38–42% correct
commands without guidance, 98% with both levels. On ordinary phrasing both arms scored 100%, so the
cost buys reliability against bash-flavoured requests, not a general improvement.

Independently of the system prompt, when a command still fails the executor appends one actionable
`[pwsh7]` line to its stderr: a parser error (English and zh-CN) gets a syntax reminder, and a
"command not recognized" error maps common POSIX names to their PowerShell 7 replacements (`grep` →
`Select-String`, `cat` → `Get-Content`, `ls` → `Get-ChildItem`, …). The hint never changes the exit
code or the command, and is appended once per settled result.

### Composer quick toggle (Web)

The client contributes a compact **pwsh7** chip to `conversation.input.right` — the list slot the
composer renders immediately before its model selector — so it sits beside the model picker in the
input row, not in a status bar. Clicking the chip opens a small menu (like the model selector's own
menu) with three levels; the chip's word and rounded border carry the state:

| Level | Chip |
|---|---|
| Forced (common + substitution) | green text, green rounded border |
| Common guidance only | blue text, blue rounded border |
| Off | grey text, grey rounded border |

Choosing a different level opens an inline confirmation inside the menu: switching mid-session
changes the model request prefix and can drop the prompt cache (KV cache), so only `Switch` posts
`POST /pwsh7/dialect`; `Cancel` or an outside click leaves the stored level untouched. The chip
polls `/pwsh7/state` every 15 s (so a change made in Settings shows up here) and hides itself when
the host has no setup routes.

### Settings page (Web)

### Settings page (Web)

The browser half also registers a **PowerShell 7** page in the Web GUI's settings menu
(`settings.section`). It is read-only until an action is chosen:

- **Status:** resolved PowerShell 7 version and executable, install directory, config path, install
  scope and method, plugin version, and whether the install is plugin-managed/removable.
- **Routing:** one click toggles between *Plugin-managed PowerShell 7* and *System default*. The
  system-default route resolves only system installations — `Program Files`, the per-user Programs
  directory, the Store alias, and `PATH` entries outside the plugin root — and falls back to stock
  DSH behavior (Windows PowerShell 5.1) when no system PowerShell 7 exists. The choice is stored as
  `route` in `config.json` and takes effect for the next `pwsh` command.
- **Self-check:** reports executable resolution, PowerShell major version, route, config validity,
  install/scope consistency, persisted `PATH` entry, shipped-package resolution, sandbox policy, and
  a running install, each as `ok` / `warn` / `fail` with details.
- **Install/repair:** starts the same shared install job as the setup dialog (user scope), with live
  progress.
- **Migrate to system:** installs PowerShell 7 under Program Files with a system `PATH` entry
  (administrator required), then removes the per-user copy and points routing at the system
  executable. An unelevated DSH host is told exactly what to do instead of hanging on UAC.
- **Uninstall:** available only for the plugin-managed per-user portable install. It removes the
  installed versions and temporary directory, drops the managed `PATH` entry, and leaves
  system/package-manager installations untouched.

### Setup dialog (Web)

The browser half renders into DSH's root `shell.overlay` slot, so it works in the ordinary Web GUI
and in the desktop shell without a second window:

- **When it opens:** on first load **even when `pwsh.exe` is already present** — that first run is
  the initial setup: it confirms whether PowerShell 7 exists, shows where it came from (automatic
  detection, `DSH_PWSH_PATH`, or the router config; system vs user installation), and lets the user
  choose the prompt-injection level. Confirming stores `onboarding.completed`, so later launches do
  not reopen it. While `pwsh.exe` is still missing, it also reopens on every failed `pwsh` run
  (`missingSeq`); "Not now" hides it until the next failed run, and a page reload opens it again
  while PowerShell 7 is still missing.
- **Detected state:** when PowerShell 7 is found the dialog shows a compact fact list — version,
  executable, scope (System / Current user) and source — plus the prompt-guidance choices. `Done`
  saves the guidance and the confirmation.
- **Updates:** the dialog asks `/pwsh7/latest` for the newest release and compares it with the
  installed executable. With a user-folder copy it offers **Update in user folder** and **Install
  system-wide** (elevated; removes the user copy and its PATH entry). With a system copy it offers
  **Update system-wide**. A failed check leaves the installed state untouched and only shows the
  error line. Settings → PowerShell 7 shows the same update actions later.
- **What it does when missing:** `Download and install` starts the shared, user-initiated
  installation job. The dialog shows `downloading → extracting → verifying`, transferred bytes,
  total, and percent. `Cancel download` aborts it.
- **Why one job:** the dialog and the settings page share one coordinator, so whichever surface the
  user starts an install from shows the same progress, and two installs cannot race on the same
  archive under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\tmp`. The model's `shell_router` tool never starts one.
- **Transport:** `GET /pwsh7/state` (snapshot), `GET /pwsh7/events` (SSE, progress coalesced to
  ~7 frames/s), `POST /pwsh7/install`, `POST /pwsh7/cancel`, `POST /pwsh7/dialect`,
  `POST /pwsh7/onboarding`, `POST /pwsh7/latest`. SSE drives smooth progress; a 3 s
  `/pwsh7/state` poll stays active as the fallback for carriers that buffer event streams. These
  routes are same-origin and accept POST bodies only as `application/json`.
- **Failure:** the dialog keeps the installer's message, offers `Retry`, and links to the official
  PowerShell releases page. A failed install does not affect `pwsh` routing until one succeeds.
- **Scope:** the dialog belongs to the Web GUI. A headless/CLI composition still gets `shell_router`
  status/diagnose/selfcheck and the settings routes when the Web app is composed, but installation
  without a browser is a manual step.

### Explicit paths

Resolution order for the pwsh executable:

1. `DSH_PWSH_PATH` environment variable
2. `pwshPath` in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\config.json`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`
4. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\powershell7\…\pwsh.exe` (portable installs, newest first)
5. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`
6. every `PATH` entry
7. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe` (Store alias)
8. `%ProgramFiles(x86)%\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`

The stock `pwsh-sandbox` row still accepts its official `pwshPath` config field; an explicit config
value takes precedence over automatic detection.

### Routing modes

`route` in `config.json` selects which executable the `pwsh` tool runs:

| Route | Resolution |
|---|---|
| `plugin` (default) | `DSH_PWSH_PATH` → `config.pwshPath` → well-known locations including the plugin-managed portable install → `PATH`; missing PowerShell 7 raises the setup hint. |
| `system` | System-installed locations only: `Program Files`, `Program Files (x86)`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs`, the Store alias, `PATH` entries outside `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7`, then Windows PowerShell 5.1 as the stock last resort. `DSH_PWSH_PATH` and `config.pwshPath` are ignored. |

The settings page switches the route at runtime (`POST /pwsh7/route`); no restart is needed.

### Config file

`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\config.json`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "route": "plugin",
  "pwshPath": "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe",
  "installed": {
    "pwsh": {
      "path": "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe",
      "version": "7.6.7",
      "method": "existing",
      "scope": "user",
      "at": "2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
  },
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## Installation (user-initiated)

Installation is only started by the user, from the Web setup dialog or Settings → PowerShell 7,
or by installing PowerShell 7 outside DSH. The model-facing tool never starts an install.

Choose `scope: "user"` (default) or `scope: "system"` in the Web dialog.

| Scope | Destination | Persistent PATH |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\powershell7\<version>` | Current user (`HKCU\Environment`) |
| `system` | `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7` | System (`HKLM` environment) |

System installation requires starting the DSH host as administrator; an unelevated host fails before downloading. User installation needs no elevation. Both preserve existing PATH entries and registry value types, avoid duplicate entries, refresh the host process PATH, and notify Windows. Already running terminals may need reopening. PATH write failures are reported as installation failures.

The settings page can migrate an existing per-user install to the system scope in one step
(`POST /pwsh7/relocate`): it installs/reuses the Program Files copy, writes the system PATH, removes
the per-user copy, and points the config at the system executable.

To install without the Web GUI, install PowerShell 7 yourself (official MSI/Store/release zip) and
set `DSH_PWSH_PATH` or `config.json` to its `pwsh.exe`.

Portable download source:

| Component | Source | Destination |
|---|---|---|
| PowerShell 7 | Latest `PowerShell/PowerShell` GitHub release, `PowerShell-*-win-x64.zip` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\powershell7\<version>\` |

- HTTPS streaming download into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\tmp`, with progress callbacks and
  cancellation.
- Extraction uses the Windows built-in `tar.exe` (bsdtar). No downloaded installer is ever executed.
- After extraction the new `pwsh.exe` is executed once to verify a major version >= 7 before it is
  written into `config.json`.
- `auto` falls back to `winget install Microsoft.PowerShell`; when elevation would be required the
  result carries the exact manual elevated command instead of hanging on UAC.
- winget receives `--scope user` or `--scope machine`; fallback never changes the selected scope.
- Live-tested on Windows: 106,364,316-byte zip downloaded in ~31 s, extracted to 244.8 MB, verified
  `7.6.7`.

## Sandbox behavior

- The executor runs through `ctx.sandbox.confine()` and the Windows ACL restricted-token runner, with
  the same `workspace-write` / `read-only` / `danger-full-access` semantics as the stock executor.
- PowerShell 7 works in all three modes (verified: `workspace-write` can write inside the workspace
  and is denied outside it; `danger-full-access` is unconfined).
- If the Windows sandbox reports `SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5)` / `grantWrite(<workspace>)`,
  the workspace DACL is missing rights. Run DSH's bundled **`diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl`** skill
  against the workspace root (it backs up and verifies), or temporarily switch the session to full
  access.

## Troubleshooting

1. Run `shell_router action="status"` and check the resolved path/version.
2. Run `shell_router action="diagnose"` to execute real commands under the current sandbox policy.
3. Common causes:
   - **Still Windows PowerShell 5.1** — detection did not find PowerShell 7. Set `DSH_PWSH_PATH` or
     the `pwshPath` config entry, then check `status` again.
   - **PowerShell 7 installed in a custom location** — set `DSH_PWSH_PATH` or `config.json`.
   - **Sandbox/ACL failure** — see the sandbox section above.

## Architecture

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Bare package row: installs `shell_router`, the system-prompt section, setup/settings routes, and the reload hook |
| `client.js` | Browser half: `shell.overlay` setup dialog plus the `settings.section` PowerShell 7 page, SSE + polling, install/route/uninstall/relocate/self-check actions, en/zh copy |
| `lib/shipped.mjs` | Loads the shipped `@deepseek-ai/*` packages from the running DSH installation (`app.asar`) |
| `lib/paths.mjs` | PowerShell 7 detection, version probing, `config.json` IO |
| `lib/route.mjs` | Routing mode persistence, system-default executable resolution, install description |
| `lib/install.mjs` | User/system-scope portable install (official zip) + winget fallback; progress and phase callbacks |
| `lib/install-scope.mjs` | Registry PATH persistence/removal (preserving value kind), elevation probes, Program Files scope |
| `lib/state.mjs` | Process-wide resolution cache shared by the executor and the tool; missing-run signal |
| `lib/maintenance.mjs` | Removes a plugin-managed per-user portable install (files, temp dir, managed PATH entries) |
| `lib/selfcheck.mjs` | Read-only self-check: executable, version, route, config, install, PATH, shipped packages, sandbox, job, routes |
| `lib/router-features.mjs` | Installs `shell_router`, the system-prompt section, the setup coordinator, and routes from the bare package row |
| `lib/setup-service.mjs` | Single job coordinator: install/relocate/uninstall/route, progress snapshots, cancel, `missingSeq` |
| `lib/setup-routes.mjs` | The eight `/pwsh7/*` routes (`state`, `events`, `install`, `cancel`, `route`, `uninstall`, `relocate`, `selfcheck`) |
| `lib/status.mjs` | `status` / `diagnose` implementations |
| `lib/executors/pwsh.mjs` | PowerShell 7 executor (extends the official `SandboxPwshExecutor`), branches on the route |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: disables the stock `pwsh-sandbox`, inserts the executor and bare package rows (Windows only) |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin-manager display metadata |

`package.json` `files` ships only the runtime pieces; `test/` stays in the repository.

## Development

```powershell
# Plain Node tests (no running DSH required)
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

- 141 tests: 137 pass, 0 fail, 4 skipped by default (2 environment-gated real-install probes,
  1 network-gated live GitHub check, 1 registry test restricted to GitHub Actions runners).
- `DSH_PWSH7_NETWORK_TESTS=1` enables the live GitHub release / HEAD checks.
- The environment override prefix is `DSH_PWSH7_*` (`APP_ROOT`, `TAR`, `NETWORK_TESTS`).

## Publishing (maintainers)

Releases are published by GitHub Actions through npm **Trusted Publishing** (OIDC) — no npm token,
OTP or repository secret is involved.

1. Bump `version` in `package.json`, commit and push to `main`.
2. Create and push a matching tag and publish a GitHub Release (for example `v0.2.0`).
3. [`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](.github/workflows/publish.yml) runs on
   `release: published`, verifies the tag matches `package.json`, runs the test suite, and publishes
   with provenance (`npm publish --access public --provenance`).

One-time npm-side setup (already configured for this repository):

```powershell
npx npm@12 trust github dsh-plugin-pwsh7 `
  --file publish.yml `
  --repo drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7 `
  --allow-publish --yes
```

Manual dry run: **Actions → Publish to npm → Run workflow**, keep `dry_run` checked. The workflow
then runs `npm publish --dry-run --provenance` without publishing.

Only `publish.yml` in `drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7` is authorized to publish. Inspect or revoke the
relationship with:

```powershell
npx npm@12 trust list dsh-plugin-pwsh7
npx npm@12 trust revoke dsh-plugin-pwsh7 --id <trust-id>
```

## Versioning note

`0.1.0` was the first public release. `0.1.1` is the first release published through npm
**Trusted Publishing** (OIDC) by GitHub Actions, and fixes the npm-hosted README cross-links.
`0.2.0` adds the Web setup dialog and moves installation into one shared coordinator. `0.2.2` adds
user/system installation scopes with persistent PATH. `0.3.0` adds the settings page with self-check,
route switching, user-scope uninstall, and migration to the system scope. `0.3.1` adds the opt-in
prompt-guidance levels (with a measured A/B), latest-release checks with user/system update actions,
the one-time setup confirmation, and the composer chip beside the model selector. `0.3.2` removes
the plugin's steady-state filesystem probes and idle host polling: cached config reads and detection,
memoized prompt assembly, and client surfaces that poll only while useful.
Earlier internal iterations (0.2.x/0.3.x) included MSYS2 bash routing and used a different package
name; that scope was removed because MSYS2/Cygwin cannot start under the DSH Windows ACL sandbox.
The historical evidence stays in the build workspace (`sandbox-recon/FINDINGS.md`), not in this
package.

## Uninstall

To remove the plugin and restore DSH's native preset:

```
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-plugin-pwsh7
```

`pwsh` then returns to DSH's default resolution. The per-user directory
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\pwsh7\` is not deleted automatically by the plugin manager; use
**Settings → PowerShell 7 → Uninstall** (or `shell_router action="uninstall"`) first if you also
want to remove the plugin-managed PowerShell 7 installation and its managed `PATH` entry.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7/blob/main/LICENSE).

# dsh-badge-notify

DSH 任务栏徽标：在 **Windows 任务栏的 DSH 图标周围**（贴着图标轮廓，不是任务栏外围）
叠画一个鼠标穿透的浮层。

- **数字徽标**：ChatGPT 风格——黑底圆角方块 + 白色数字＝**未读**的已完成会话数。
  徽标**坐在图标右上角上方**（中心抬升 `badge.lift`×徽标边长，默认 0.5＝徽标底边正贴着图标顶边），
  所以不再遮住图标本身。
  - 「未读」与 DSH 侧边栏的小绿点**同义**：会话跑完时你正在看它就不计数；跑完后你打开它即视为已读，计数自动减掉
  - 想改回「所有完成都计数」：`badge.unreadOnly: false`
- **提示点**：中心落在图标左边缘线上，自上而下排列。**每种提示只有一个点**（`dots.group: "kind"`）
  - 黑点 = 有提问待回答（`user-questions/request`）——需要人工介入
  - 黄点 = 有权限申请待批准（`approval/request`）
  - 第一个点与徽标**同一水平线**（左上角位置），第二个点落在左边中点；同类的多个待处理仍只有一个点
  - 想回到“每个待处理项一个点”，把 `dots.group` 改成 `"item"`

## 截图

DSH 任务栏图标上的实际效果（左边黑点=待回答，左下黄点=待批准，右上角标=未读完成数）：

![DSH 任务栏图标](screenshots/icon.png)

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-badge-notify
```

也可以直接从 GitHub 源码安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:dthcle/dsh-badge-notify
```

装完**不用重启 DSH**：宿主半端会自动把浮层载荷部署到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\`
并拉起浮层，几秒内就能在任务栏的 DSH 图标上看到徽标。
在 **设置 → 任务徽标**（独立设置页，与「内置插件」平级）里可以看状态、启停、清零。

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-badge-notify
```

### 运行要求

- **平台**：Windows 10 / 11（靠 UI Automation 定位任务栏按钮 + 分层窗口叠画，Windows 专有）
- **DSH**：桌面版（`desktop` profile）。浮层需要一个能显示任务栏的桌面会话
- **无需管理员权限**：不注入进程、不读跨进程内存，只用 UIA 读取按钮坐标
- **不联网**：没有外部服务，全部本地运行
- **资源占用**：约 0.7% 单核 CPU、~145 MB 内存（其中 ~91 MB 是 PowerShell + WinForms 的运行时地板）

> 浮层找的是**桌面版 DSH** 那个任务栏按钮（`Appid: com.deepseek.dsh`），所以装到这个 App
> 正在用的 profile 里才有效——默认是 `desktop`。如果你启动时用的是别的 profile 名，
> 把命令里的 `--profile desktop` 换成你的那个即可。

## 形态

- **Host 半端**（`lib/index.js`，跑在 DSH 进程里）：订阅 `agent/status`（running→idle 记一次
  完成）、`user-questions/request`、`approval/request`（waterfall 观察者，用 `prepend` 抢在
  应答方之前，否则请求被应答方 claim 后就看不到了）。状态写入 `state.json`，并注册
  `/api/dsh-badge-notify/*` 三条 loopback 路由与系统提示词说明。
- **浮层半端**（`assets/BadgeNotify.ps1`，独立进程）：用 **UI Automation** 定位 DSH 的任务栏按钮
  （`Appid: com.deepseek.dsh`，不需要提权、不碰跨进程内存），再从按钮自身像素里量出
  **图标本体** 的位置，最后用 `UpdateLayeredWindow` 画带 alpha 的黑底白字徽标与提示点。
- **鼠标穿透**（默认）：`WS_EX_TRANSPARENT`，不挡任务栏图标的点击。窗口不进 Alt+Tab、不抢焦点。
- **脱离宿主**：宿主 spawn 时 `windowsHide`（CREATE_NO_WINDOW），DSH 重启不影响已在跑的浮层。

## 图标定位（为什么要量像素）

任务栏按钮（UIA 给的 66×72）比图标本体大得多，直接把徽标贴在按钮角落就会落在**图标外围**
——所以浮层会截取按钮一帧，取众数色当背景，对差异像素做**连通分量**分析，取最靠近中心的那一块
（真图标），得到**字形外接框**。这条路上有两类噪声被自动排除：相邻按钮的边缘带、
运行中应用的下划线指示条。量不出来时回退到“按钮中心按 `iconScale` 取方形”的几何估算。

锚点用的是这个外接框（`anchor.iconPad` 放大系数，默认 `1.0`＝正好是字形轮廓）：

- 徽标中心 = 外接框**右上角**再向上抬 `badge.lift`×徽标边长（默认 0.5）
- 提示点中心 = 外接框**左边缘**；第一个点默认与徽标中心同高（`dots.start: badge`），
  之后按 `点径 + dots.gap` 依次向下，直到图标底边（点太多时自动压缩间距并缩小点径）

因为标记在轮廓上/轮廓外，浮层画布比图标外接框四周大 `pad` 像素（= 抬升量/半标记 + 描边 + 2），
窗口也相应外扩。27×20 的鲸鱼图标上实测：`pad=20`，画布 67×60，徽标 16px、提示点 15px。

**量像素时必须先把浮层藏起来**：否则自己画的徽标会被当成“图标墨迹”，连通分量一轮比一轮大
（实测 30→32→35→38px 每 30 秒膨胀一次），徽标和提示点会慢慢爬离图标。

## 配置

`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\config.json`（用户文件：缺失才写；架构版本 `configVersion` 变化时
刷新，旧文件备份为 `config.json.bak`）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor.target` | `icon` | `icon`＝贴图标本体；`button`＝贴整个按钮矩形 |
| `anchor.referencePx` | `27` | 调参时用的图标基准边：所有**绝对像素**键都按 `基准边/referencePx` 缩放，换机器等比 |
| `anchor.iconScale` | `0.5` | 量不出图标时的方形边长比例（相对按钮短边） |
| `anchor.iconPad` | `1.0` | 字形外接框放大系数：`1.0`＝锚点正好在字形轮廓上 |
| `anchor.calibrate` | `true` | 关掉就只用几何估算 |
| `anchor.offsetX/Y` | `0` | 浮层整体位移 |
| `anchor.iconOffsetX/Y` | `0` | 图标框位移（微调到“正贴在图标上”） |
| `badge.unreadOnly` | `true` | `true`＝只统计**未读**的完成（与绿点同义）；`false`＝所有完成都计数 |
| `attention.minVisibleMs` | `1500` | 提示标记的最短可见时间：请求若在几毫秒内就被答复，标记仍会保留这么久，否则浮层根本来不及画 |
| `badge.sizeRatio` | `0.73` | 徽标边长 ÷ 图标边长（`badge.size>0` 时改用绝对像素） |
| `badge.lift` | `0.5` | 徽标中心相对图标右上角抬高多少（×徽标边长）：`0.5`＝徽标底边贴着图标顶边，`0`＝中心落在角上 |
| `badge.insetX/Y` | `0` / `3` | 徽标中心再往左/往下微调多少像素 |
| `badge.fontSizeRatio` | `0.8` | 数字字号 ÷ 徽标边长（`badge.fontSize>0` 时改用绝对像素）；数字按**真实墨迹**居中，`textOffsetX/Y` 可再光学微调 |
| `dots.sizeRatio` | `0.56` | 提示点直径 ÷ 图标边长（`dots.size>0` 时改用绝对像素） |
| `dots.gap` | `3` | 提示点之间的缝；`fit` 模式下点太多会自动压缩，保证不越过图标底边 |
| `dots.start` | `badge` | `badge`＝第一个点与徽标同一水平线；`corner`＝第一个点落在图标左上角 |
| `dots.mode` | `fit` | `fit`＝压缩点径塞进图标高度；`fixed`＝保持点径+缝，允许向图标下方溢出 |
| `dots.group` | `kind` | `kind`＝每种提示一个点（黑点/黄点各最多一个）；`item`＝每个待处理项一个点 |
| `dots.insetX` | `-3` | 提示点**中心**相对图标左边缘的横移量 |
| `dots.insetY` | `2` | 第一个点再往下多少像素 |
| `dots.max` | `2` | 最多画几个点 |
| `dots.order` | `kind` | `kind`＝先黑点后黄点；`time`＝按发生时间 |
| `clickThrough` | `true` | 鼠标穿透 |
| `pollMs` | `500` | 状态轮询间隔 |
| `buttonRefreshMs` | `4000` | 按钮矩形重读间隔（UIA 跨进程调用，别设太小：会吃 CPU） |
| `buttonSearchMs` | `120000` | 健康元素的后台重发现间隔（防 explorer 重启后句柄失效） |
| `buttonRetryMs` | `4000` | 查找失败后的重试间隔（否则一次 UIA 抖动会白屏一整个慢周期） |

改完约 2 秒内自动生效（浮层持续盯着 `config.json` 的修改时间，变了就重读、重新校准图标框并重画）。

尺寸的自适应基准是“图标方形边长”＝`max(字形宽,字形高) × iconPad`；在 27×20 的 DSH 鲸鱼图标上
即 27px。所有尺寸都是它的比例，剩下的绝对像素键再按 `基准边 / anchor.referencePx` 缩放
（本机 `referencePx = 27`，即 1:1），所以换台电脑、换 DPI、换任务栏缩放都只会等比变化。

## 手动调参（不想改配置文件时）

往数据目录写一份 `preview.json`，浮层就固定画这些标记、忽略真实事件，方便对着任务栏调
`config.json`（改完约 2 秒生效）：

```json
{ "enabled": true, "count": 8, "dots": ["question", "approval"] }
```

删掉该文件（或 `"enabled": false`）立刻回到实时状态。模板见 `assets/preview.example.json`。

## 管理 API（仅 loopback POST）

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/status` | 运行状态 / pid / 已完成数 / 待处理列表 |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/start` | 部署（含载荷升级：内容变了就重启浮层）+ 拉起 |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/stop` | 停止浮层（记 `stopped.flag`，DSH 重启不会自动拉回） |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/clear` | 已完成计数清零 |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/read` | 客户端半端上报「当前主视图打开的会话集合」`{"sessionIds":[...]}`，这些会话视为已读、不再计数 |

Web GUI：**设置 → 任务徽标**（独立设置页：状态点、启停、清零、待处理列表，5s 轮询）。

### 未读语义从哪来

DSH 侧边栏的绿点由客户端 `completionUnread` 决定（`dsh-client-ui-session`），它只在
`retainedBy.mainView > 0`（该会话正开在主视图）时消除。这个保留计数**只存在于浏览器侧**，
宿主完全不知情，所以插件用一个客户端半端把这份状态镜像给宿主：

- 订阅 `ctx.get('sessions')` 的列表快照 + 每个会话的 `retainInfo(id)`；
- `retainedBy.mainView > 0` 的会话即「已读」，整集 POST 到 `/read`；
- 宿主据此维护两件事：正在看的会话完成时不计入、已读的会话从计数里退掉。

不猜测点击、不使用计时器，规则与 DSH 绿点完全一致。

## 诊断

- `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\logs\host.log`：宿主半端各阶段（apply 各步、boot 结果、
  事件命中）。这里能看到 `apply: xxx FAILED`——宿主里的异常否则只会表现为“插件没反应”。
- `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\logs\badge-notify.log`：浮层半端。每次画面变化记一行：
  ```
  draw box 2039,2110 27x27 source=measured ink=316 glyph=27x20@32,36 bg=235,239,249
  anchor ink 2040,2115 27x20
  frame count=2 dots=1 canvas=51x44@2028,2103 pad=12 badge=16 dot=9 icon=27x20
  ```
  `draw box` 是按钮内图标框，`anchor ink` 是真正用来定位的**字形外接框**，
  `canvas` 是分层窗口的位置与大小。查“徽标跑到哪去了”看这三行最快。
  若出现 `slow tick: previous poll took ...ms (UIA may be blocking)`，说明某次 UIA 调用卡了很久
  （树劣化时会发生）；若出现 `UIA: no DSH button among N taskbar buttons: ...`，会一并列出
  任务栏上真实存在的按钮，便于核对 `buttonMatch`。
- 手动体检（会打印测到的图标框与外接框，然后退出，不进消息循环）：
  ```powershell
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\DshBadgeNotify\BadgeNotify.ps1" -Calibrate
  ```
  输出形如 `MEASURED icon: 2039,2110 27x27 ... buttonOffset=+19,+22` +
  `ANCHOR ink  : 2040,2115 27x20`。

## 已知坑（实现记录）

- **`-shl` 会按左操作数类型截断**：`[byte]235 -shl 16` 在 PowerShell 里回绕成 0，颜色打包必须用
  乘法（`[int]$c.R * 65536`）。
- **UIA 要非沙箱进程**：在受限 token 下 `OpenProcess` 拿 explorer 会被拒、UIA 只看得到几十个元素，
  任务栏按钮根本不出现。由 DSH 宿主 spawn 的进程不受此限。
- **任务栏按钮会移动**：窗口增减都会改变它，所以按钮位置要周期性重定位，不能缓存太久。
  但 UIA 的跨进程属性读取不便宜（每 2.5s 一次实测 ~6% 单核），现在按 `buttonRefreshMs`
  读矩形、`buttonSearchMs` 才做一次任务栏内 `FindAll`，空闲占用约 0.4%。
- **UIA 树会劣化，且桌面级搜索会被坏元素永久阻塞**：实测一次 explorer 树劣化后，
  从桌面根节点搜任务栏按钮返回 190 个重复项（正常 3 个），其中某个元素属性读取直接卡死，
  把整个轮询线程钉住（CPU 33%、无日志、无重绘）。现在只在 `Shell_TrayWnd` 内搜索
  （9ms vs ~3000ms）、候选先校验再采用、坏元素跳过，并有 `slow tick` 看门狗兜底。
- **UIA 会瞬时抽风**：按钮矩形读取失败、或一次 `FindAll` 找不到按钮都可能发生。此时
  **保留上一次的矩形继续画**，下一轮立刻重试（`buttonRetryMs`），而不是当场隐藏。
- **状态文件的 mtime 不能单独当变更依据**：`state.json` 用 (mtime, 长度) 双重判断，
  另外每 2.5s 无条件重解析一次，避免“时间戳同刻改写”被漏掉。
- **`Add-Type` 编译的 C# 里不要用 `Bitmap.GetHbitmap`** 给 `UpdateLayeredWindow`：它不做
  预乘 alpha，圆角会出现亮边；本插件自己 `CreateDIBSection` 后逐像素预乘。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# MCP连接器：在 DeepSeek Harness 接入、查找和排障 MCP Server

> DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 接入与管理面板：超百个 MCP连接器，一个入口完成 MCP Server 授权配置、跨连接工具搜索与连接排障。

从持续更新的连接器目录接入 MCP Server；跨当前范围内已启用连接查找工具，查看易读参数、来源和最后成功缓存时间，并在发现异常时检查连接或重新发现工具。支持 OAuth 2.0 PKCE、API Key、Streamable HTTP/stdio 与 `mcpServers` JSON 导入。

OAuth 是否可用取决于服务商的客户端注册、账号权限与授权政策；连接已保存、工具已发现和业务调用成功应分别验证。

> 注：“技能扩展”指通过 MCP 工具和 Prompt 扩展智能体能力，本包不会伪装成独立 DSH Skill。

[English](README.en.md)

### 工具查找与故障处理

在“工具”页统一查找当前工作区可见、已启用连接的工具。输入工具名或描述，再按连接、服务和最近发现状态筛选；点击“参数详情”查看类型、必填项与嵌套结构。未选择工作区时，仅展示全局连接。

结果标注来源和最后成功缓存时间。发现失败时仍可查看已有缓存，但不代表服务当前可调用。展开“连接状态与故障处理”，按建议使用“检查连接”或“重新发现工具”。健康连接五分钟后到期，页面保持连接时后台检查到期任务；失败时退避，鉴权失败暂停自动重试。

详见[工具工作台教程](docs/USER-GUIDE.md#51-工具工作台统一查找工具)。工具页用于发现与诊断，不执行目标工具；参数摘要与原始安全缓存均有裁剪边界。

[用户手册](docs/USER-GUIDE.md) · [第三方连接器上架指南](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md) · [首次贡献](docs/FIRST-CONTRIBUTION.md) · [参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/issues)

[![CI](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mcp-connector.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mcp-connector)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-mcp-connector.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mcp-connector)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector?style=flat)](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/stargazers)
[![GitHub forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector?style=flat)](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/forks)
[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector)](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/releases/latest)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Registry connectors](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fduhu2000%2Fdsh-mcp-connector-registry%2Fmain%2Fcatalog-stats.json&query=%24.registryCount&label=Registry%20connectors&color=5865f2)](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/catalog-stats.json)
[![Marketplace cards](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fduhu2000%2Fdsh-mcp-connector-registry%2Fmain%2Fcatalog-stats.json&query=%24.marketCount&label=Marketplace%20cards&color=16a34a)](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/catalog-stats.json)

## 30 秒开始

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-connector
```

安装或升级后完全重启 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 或 `dsh web`，然后打开左侧「MCP连接器」；也可从“设置 → 插件 → 插件配置 → MCP连接器”直接打开。

首次使用建议依次确认：连接已保存且范围正确 → “工具”页能找到预期工具与来源 → 在正常 DSH 会话中通过 Host 审批链完成一次服务商许可的只读调用。缓存可见不等于当前服务可调用。

[首次成功入口：安装 → 连接 → 找到工具 → 首次只读调用](docs/tutorials/README.md)。按任务深入：[三个可验收场景包](docs/tutorials/FIRST-SUCCESS-SCENARIOS.md) · [迁移现有 `mcpServers` JSON](docs/tutorials/JSON-MIGRATION.md) · [OAuth 授权诊断](docs/tutorials/OAUTH-DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [跨连接找工具与恢复](docs/tutorials/TOOL-SEARCH-RECOVERY.md) · [可信状态文案](docs/tutorials/TRUSTED-STATUS-COPY.md)。

![MCP 连接器 43 秒演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/main/docs/demo.gif)

如果它帮你更快地接入 MCP Server，欢迎 [GitHub 点个 Star](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/stargazers)、[提交新的连接器](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md)或[参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

## MCP连接器能做什么

| 能力 | 用户得到什么 |
|---|---|
| 持续更新的连接器目录 | 浏览精选与 9 类业务连接器；Registry 更新后刷新即可获取新卡片 |
| 多种接入方式 | 使用 OAuth 2.0 PKCE、API Key、Streamable HTTP/stdio 或 `mcpServers` JSON 接入 |
| 跨连接工具查找 | 在当前范围内已启用连接的最后成功缓存中按名称或描述搜索，并按连接、服务和状态筛选 |
| 易读参数与来源 | 查看类型、必填、枚举、嵌套摘要、来源、缓存时间及安全裁剪后的 Schema |
| 连接排障 | 根据明确的阶段和错误码检查连接或重新发现工具，同时保留可用的最后成功缓存 |
| 作用域与治理 | 管理 project/global 可见范围以及 Connection、Server、Tool 三层规则 |
| 按会话工具注入 | 连接保持在线，对选定连接默认隐藏 schema，只在当前 Agent 临时激活精确工具 |
| 安全生命周期 | 支持凭据本机存储、授权刷新、脱敏备份、快照回滚及失败时保留原连接 |
| 插件更新 | 检测新版本，并在宿主提供兼容 Update Provider 时显示进度、失败原因和回滚结果 |

## 功能

- 左侧主导航入口：DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2` 使用官方 `sidebar.panellist` 行与原生主面板，继承宿主选中态、折叠提示和无障碍行为；DSH `0.1.x` 自动回退到兼容入口。
- 侧边栏入口可按当前 profile 隐藏；隐藏后仍可从“设置 → 插件 → 插件配置 → MCP连接器”临时打开现有连接器弹框，用完即关。
- 图形化市场：默认“全部”按推荐与 9 类业务分类分章节展示，每章先展示 4 张并可展开；分类栏固定可见，单分类页展示全部卡片。
- 图形化添加：手动 HTTP/stdio、`mcpServers` JSON、连接器描述 URL 三种入口，失败时保留表单并给出修复建议。
- 连接器详情：精选 Prompt 优先展示，点击可带入 DSH 新会话；工具按 Server 分组，支持描述、搜索、参数详情和独立滚动。实时发现失败时显示带时间/陈旧标记的最后成功工具缓存。
- 实时状态：页面通过同源 SSE 接收连接、目录、健康、工具、治理和作用域变化通知并自动刷新；事件不携带连接标识、端点、错误或凭据。
- Prompt 模板：使用 `{{company}}` 等变量，发送前填写真实查询主体。
- 三种接入：OAuth 2.0 PKCE、自定义 HTTP/stdio、导入 `mcpServers` JSON；也支持从连接器描述 URL 安装。OAuth 动态注册兼容公共客户端以及 `client_secret_post` / `client_secret_basic` 机密客户端。
- 市场 Bearer/API Key 连接器先执行 MCP initialize 连通性与凭据校验，全部 HTTP Server 通过后才持久化凭据并进入“已安装”；stdio 卡片可声明多个本机凭据字段及其环境变量映射。
- 生命周期管理：连接持久化、重启恢复、启停、断开、OAuth 自动刷新/退避恢复与撤销；同 issuer 卡片共享一次授权，跨进程锁与独立原子 Grant journal 防止 Desktop/Web 并行时重复消耗 Refresh Token。
- 配置原地编辑：自定义和 JSON 导入连接可在“已安装”中编辑标准化 JSON 并重新连接；敏感值以本机保留标记处理，校验、启动或保存失败时原连接继续可用。
- 本地参数覆盖（#146，0.2.76）：无凭据市场 stdio 连接支持在首次连接确认框填写“高级本地参数”，以及在已安装列表编辑 `argsAppend`、`env`、`cwd`，不修改目录或连接身份；已有值不回传浏览器，支持快照恢复和清除覆盖。首次连接留空沿用市场参数，已有连接留空保留原覆盖；启动失败保留表单可修改重试。不支持 OAuth、凭据绑定、CLI 桥接或完整参数替换；真实 Desktop/Windows 验收尚未完成。
- 配置备份：一键复制/下载可再次导入的脱敏 JSON；连接变更前自动保存最多 20 个本机快照，支持预览与原子恢复。凭据、本地路径和 OAuth Grant 不进入导出结果。
- 连接作用域：新连接可选当前 Workspace 项目或 profile 全局；支持先预览 Server/工具影响，再复制、移动或按 revision 回滚。凭据只存一份，project-only 工具由 DSH Host 强制隔离。
- 三层治理：Connection、Server、Tool 规则按 Tool > Server > Connection > 默认允许解析；变更先预览、按 revision 提交并可回滚，由 DSH Host 的 schema/lookup/dispatch restriction 与最终执行 Guard 真实生效。
- 按会话工具注入：“已安装”连接可选“始终注入”或“按会话启用”。后者不断开 Server，只由 Host 在当前 Agent 隐藏业务工具；明确预览和确认后临时激活精确工具，最长 30 分钟，会话或进程结束后清空。
- 可解释诊断：只报告实际观察结果；未检查或 Host 状态不可见时显示“状态未知”，并提供失败阶段、稳定错误码、建议动作、检查时间和进程内最近成功时间。
- 目录运营：内置目录、远程 registry、本地覆盖，支持 `published` 上下架与 `featured` 精选。
- 独立远程 Registry：新市场卡片合并后客户端刷新即可见，无需重新发布 npm；远程不可用时自动回退内置目录。
- 插件版本与一键更新：版本发现独立于安装来源；页面通过 Update Provider 适配层探测安全更新能力。DSH Market API v1 是首个适配器，支持进度、稳定失败码、回滚及按宿主能力提供的重启/刷新操作；无可用 Provider 时回退到当前插件市场或 npm。
- Registry 工具链：Schema/唯一性/密钥审计、MCP/OAuth 无凭据探针、每周健康巡检。
- 平滑迁移：显式扫描并复制两个旧企查查 OAuth 插件授权；检测到旧插件仍启用并管理同名 Server 时阻断重复连接，避免凭据相互覆盖。
- 对话工具：`mcp_connector_catalog`、`connect`、`configure`、`import_json`、`export_config`、`snapshot`、`install_from_url`、`status`、`scope`、`health_check`、`policy`、`set_enabled`、`session_tools`、`disconnect`、`refresh_catalog`、`publish`、`tools_list`、`tool_search`、`tool_detail`。搜索/详情只做渐进式能力发现，不执行目标 MCP 工具。

## 安装

要求：DeepSeek Harness Desktop/web profile，Node.js 20 或更高版本。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-connector
```

也可使用安装脚本：

```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/main/install.sh)
```

重复执行安装命令即可升级。安装或升级后需完全退出并重启 DeepSeek Harness Desktop；使用 `dsh web` 时需先停止原进程再启动，`EADDRINUSE 127.0.0.1:3080` 表示已有实例正在运行。

## 使用

1. 点击左侧“MCP连接器”，或从“设置 → 插件 → 插件配置 → MCP连接器”点击“打开 MCP连接器”。
2. 在市场中选择连接器，确认“当前项目”或“所有项目（全局）”，再完成授权或配置。
3. 打开卡片详情，可点击示例 Prompt 的发送按钮，在当前工作区创建/复用空白会话并写入草稿。
4. 在“已安装”或对话工具中查看、停用、恢复或断开连接。
5. 连接后打开“工具”页，按工具名或描述查找能力，使用连接/服务筛选定位来源；授权、费用及正式调用仍由相应服务与 DSH Host 管理。

连接成功后，工具按 `mcp__<serverName>__*` 前缀提供给模型。

分类浏览、鉴权与连接状态、自定义 HTTP/stdio、JSON 导入、脱敏备份、可解释诊断、兼容矩阵、责任边界与故障排查见完整的[用户手册](docs/USER-GUIDE.md)。

## 配置

Bundle 默认配置位于 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: mcp-connector
  name: dsh-mcp-connector
  config:
    catalogUrl: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry@main/catalog.json'
    persistSecrets: true
    entryPrefix: mcp
    refreshSkewMs: 300000
    openBrowser: true
    showSidebarEntry: true
    compactManagementTools: false
    frameAncestors: ['self']
```

`catalogUrl` 默认通过 jsDelivr CDN 读取公共 [dsh-mcp-connector-registry](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry)，支持 ETag/TTL 缓存；主源失败时自动尝试 GitHub raw 备用源，再回退到上次缓存或随包内置目录。jsDelivr 的分支 URL 可能存在缓存延迟，因此 Registry 合并后的新卡片不保证秒级出现。需要离线/私有模式时可将 `catalogUrl` 显式设为空字符串；显式配置其他目录 URL 时不会自动切换到公共备用源。

远程目录请求（包括备用源）支持 `HTTP_PROXY`、`HTTPS_PROXY`、`NO_PROXY` 及其小写形式；同时存在时小写变量优先，未设置 `HTTPS_PROXY` 时 HTTPS 请求使用 `HTTP_PROXY`。代理地址须为 HTTP(S) URL；需要直连的目标可加入 `NO_PROXY`（例如 `localhost,127.0.0.1`）。Node.js 20+ 无需添加 `--use-env-proxy`；此行为不会修改 Host 的全局 fetch dispatcher 或 MCP 传输配置。

代理变量必须存在于正在运行的 DSH 进程中。修改后请完全退出并重启 DSH Desktop，或从已设置变量的终端启动 `dsh web`；修改 Windows 用户环境变量不会更新已有进程。连接器不会读取系统代理设置，也不会猜测本机代理地址。

`showSidebarEntry` 默认为 `true`。用户可在 DSH 插件配置页覆盖该值；关闭后只隐藏侧边栏快捷入口，不停用连接器、已连接 MCP Server 或工具。

`compactManagementTools` 默认为 `false`，兼容原有对话管理工具。希望降低管理工具上下文开销时，可在插件配置中设为 `true` 并重载插件（必要时重启 DSH），下一次推理使用新工具集：

- 只注册 `mcp_connector_discover`（市场、连接状态、缓存工具搜索/详情）和 `mcp_connector_session_tools`（原有会话工具可见性管理）两个入口。
- 连接、授权、编辑、导入、快照、迁移等管理操作使用 **MCP连接器界面**；精简模式没有任意工具执行代理，也不自动加载全部管理工具。纯对话部署或依赖旧工具名的自动化应保持 `false`。
- 此开关不减少已连接服务的业务工具数量，不停用连接、不迁移凭据、不修改作用域/治理规则。业务工具需要按需可见时，仍使用原有“按会话启用”。会话确认、TTL 与 Host 审批保持不变。
- 例如发现入口可用 `{"action":"search","query":"天气","limit":5}`；查询连接状态可用 `{"action":"status"}`。详情使用 `action=detail` 和必填 `toolName`，市场搜索使用 `action=catalog` 与可选 `keyword`。
- 设回 `false` 并重载插件可恢复旧管理工具名；不要同时运行两份插件。工具数量和 schema 大小的减少不等于实测 token 或费用节省。

`frameAncestors` 默认为 `['self']`，即面板页面（`/mcp-connector/ui/`）的 CSP 只允许同源页面内嵌，是既有行为，不做任何放宽。在桌面壳（Tauri/Electron）里把面板嵌进壳窗口时，祖先源与面板自身不同源，浏览器会以 `Framing '...' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "frame-ancestors 'self'"` 拦截并导致面板白屏；此时需要由部署方/用户显式追加外壳源：

```yaml
frameAncestors: ['self', 'http://tauri.localhost', 'tauri://localhost']
```

这是有意的安全取舍，不是遗漏：`frame-ancestors` 无法验证嵌入方到底是谁，所以插件不会默认把 Tauri 之类的外壳源硬编码进去——写进白名单就等于允许任何跑在该源上的页面内嵌本机面板。取值只接受 CSP 关键字（`self` / `none` / `*`）与 host-source（`https://*.example.com`、`127.0.0.1:3080`、`tauri://localhost`、`http://tauri.localhost:1420` 等，可带 scheme、端口与路径）；含 `;`、逗号、空格或 `'unsafe-inline'` 一类非 host-source 关键字的值会被整条丢弃（避免 CSP 头注入），过滤后为空则回退 `['self']`，而不是放行任意源。请只填自己信任的源。

## 兼容性与责任边界

| 项目 | 当前边界 |
|---|---|
| 宿主与运行时 | DSH Desktop / `web` profile，Node.js 20+ |
| MCP 客户端 | 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` `^0.1.1-rc.2` |
| 传输 | Streamable HTTP、stdio；旧 `sse` 归一为 Streamable HTTP |
| 配置作用域 | Workspace project / profile global；全局由项目继承，Host 强制隔离，支持预览、复制/移动和 revision 回滚 |
| 配置交换 | JSON 导入、脱敏导出、最多 20 个本机快照、预览与原子恢复 |
| 治理与执行 | Connection / Server / Tool allow/deny，预览、revision 提交与回滚；暂无工具试运行 |
| 会话注入 | 默认 always；可对单条连接显式选择 session，由 Host restriction + guard 按 Agent 隔离，内存 TTL 最长 30 分钟 |

插件负责目录、授权、连接记录、官方客户端条目、治理规则、只读健康检查、工具发现和诊断；DSH Host 与官方 MCP 客户端负责 transport、stdio 子进程、工具注册、正式工具执行及权限/审批链。治理通过 Host 官方 restriction/guard 生效，插件不会从浏览器旁路调用 MCP 工具。详细状态语义、限制与排障见[用户手册第 7–10 节](docs/USER-GUIDE.md#75-如何理解连接诊断)。

## 开发与发布门禁

```bash
npm run check
npm run marketing:check:live
npm run registry:build
npm run registry:validate
npm run market:check
npm run dev:ui
```

`marketing/metadata.json` 是 npm 描述/关键词、GitHub About/Topics、中英文首屏 CTA 和外部分发文案的事实源。`check` 会离线阻断仓库内漂移；`marketing:check:live` 进一步核对线上 GitHub 与 npm，供元数据调整和月度复盘时执行。`market:check` 检查外部 DSH 市场 PR 与线上目录；`dev:ui` 启动不含真实凭据的本地 mock 市场。CI 使用 `--legacy-peer-deps` 安装显式测试依赖，DSH 运行期 peer 仍由 Host 提供。`v*` Tag 会触发 GitHub Actions；Tag 必须与 `package.json` 版本一致。Release 通过 npm Trusted Publishing (GitHub OIDC) 发布，不依赖长期 `NPM_TOKEN`。

公共 Registry 每次合并后会生成 `catalog-stats.json`；本仓库的定时工作流每小时同步中英文介绍和统计快照。npm 页面中的静态正文随版本发布更新，上方动态统计徽标则直接读取 Registry，可在不发布新 npm 版本时保持实时数量一致。

## 安全与限制

- 凭证只持久化在本机 DSH storage 边界：连接记录使用 storage domain，OAuth 轮换凭据同步保存到 `$DSH_HOME/storages/mcp_connector_grants_v1`。该目录为 0700、文件为 0600；凭证不进入市场目录、Git 仓库、页面、日志或对话历史。
- 市场 Key/Token 校验失败时不写入 storage domain；鉴权、超时、DNS、TLS/网络错误会分类提示。
- 未检查或 Host 状态不可见时显示“状态未知”，不会冒充健康；健康摘要与最近成功时间当前只保留在插件进程内。
- 外部 URL 默认仅允许 HTTPS，HTTP 默认仅允许回环地址。用户自建连接可在明确风险确认后放行 RFC1918 IPv4 / RFC4193 IPv6 ULA 字面量；域名、公网 HTTP、链路本地与云元数据地址仍拒绝。
- 远程目录/描述响应限制 2 MiB，Web API 请求限制 1 MiB；原始 JSON 在归一化前扫描凭据字段。
- 完整覆盖 Streamable HTTP 与 stdio；旧 `sse` 配置在导入/恢复时归一为 Streamable HTTP。重启恢复 stdio 连接时使用透明的启动保护进程包装原命令，`env/cwd` 与持久化记录保持不变；工具注册和正式执行仍由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 负责。
- 恢复连接的 `server/discover`、`initialize` 与首次 `tools/list`（含分页）按 `requestTimeoutMs` 限时，最长每次 15 秒；超时结束该连接的子进程，而不是让可选 MCP 卡住 Host 启动。连接保持启用，首次发现完成后的请求仍使用 Host 原有超时。
- 对本身不是 MCP Server 的官方 CLI，使用独立的[受控 CLI Provider](docs/CLI-PROVIDERS.md)桥接为 stdio MCP；只允许代码登记的命令与参数，首个钉钉 `dws` Provider 仅开放只读能力。
- stdio 会启动本机进程：仅导入或连接可信命令/软件包。市场目录只能用 `credentialFields` + `credentialBindings` 声明输入与 env 映射，不得携带真实 token/secret；用户填写值只写入本机连接记录并交给 Host。
- OAuth DCR 的 `client_secret` 与 Access/Refresh Token 采用相同的本机存储边界，不会进入市场 API、状态输出或日志。
- OAuth 连接失败会标明资源发现、服务发现、客户端注册、授权回调或 Token 换取阶段；DCR HTTP 403 表示服务商拒绝未准入客户端，不是用户未点击授权。
- 脱敏导出把 Token/API Key、静态 Header/env 值、stdio 参数、本地目录及带查询参数的 URL 替换为占位符；OAuth 只保留重新授权引用。快照中的完整配置仍只在当前 profile 的 storage domain 内。
- 顶部入口通过 DSH 稳定 `data-slot` 定位并使用 React Portal；DSH 若移除该标记，入口会回退到底部，不影响连接器功能。
- 旧授权迁移必须显式确认，只复制不删除；确认新连接可用后再手动停用旧插件。
- project/global 作用域仅在当前 DSH profile 内生效；不会跨 profile 同步。删除 Workspace 后，原 project-only 绑定保持 fail closed，需手动移动到其他项目或全局。
- 当前没有工具试运行；治理与作用域都由 DSH Host 正式工具执行链强制应用。试运行已完成官方 API 复核，但在 out-of-turn 审批编排和 MCP 副作用元数据缺口补齐前保持 design blocked。快照不能恢复服务端已撤销的 OAuth Grant。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-genshin-account

DeepSeek Harness 插件：把**你的原神账号**读进来 —— 角色练度、命座、天赋、面板、武器、圣遗物 —— 然后在**对话里直接问**（agent 调用工具查），也能在 **GUI 里看**（侧边栏「原神账号」页面）。

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reads your Genshin Impact account (characters, talents, weapons, artifacts) into one canonical snapshot and exposes it both as **agent tools** and as a **GUI page**.

---

## 数据从哪来

国服没有"填个 UID 就能查"的公开接口：`api-takumi-record.mihoyo.com` 上的每个读取接口都要求登录态，并且在返回数据前要求一次人机验证。插件把这两步都做完了，只有一条数据链路：

| 步骤 | 接口 / 机制 |
| --- | --- |
| 1. 扫码登录 | `passport-api.miyoushe.com/account/ma-cn-passport/web/createQRLogin` → `queryQRLoginStatus`，确认后从 `Set-Cookie` 得到 `ltoken_v2` / `ltmid_v2` —— 会话归插件自己所有 |
| 2. 申请验证任务 | `GET /game_record/app/card/wapi/createVerification?is_high=true` → geetest 的 `gt` + `challenge` |
| 3. 拖滑块 | 页面内加载 geetest v3 控件，产出 `geetest_challenge` + `geetest_validate`；`x-rpc-challenge_path` 决定这次验证解锁哪个接口（`/index` 与 `/character/list` 分别验证） |
| 4. 兑换通行证 | `POST /game_record/app/card/wapi/verifyVerification` → `x-rpc-challenge` |
| 5. 读取数据 | `GET /game_record/app/genshin/api/index`、`POST /character/detail`，带上 `x-rpc-challenge` |

能读到：账号概览（昵称/等级/区服/成就/活跃天数）、全部角色（等级、命座、三段天赋、武器、五件圣遗物含每条副词条与强化值）。

> 这套流程与 Snap.Hutao 的 `CardClient` + `GeetestService` 一致（它的 `RetryIf1034Async` 就是"遇 1034 → 验证 → 带 `x-rpc-challenge` 重发"）。人机验证是官方要求，插件只把这一步搬到自己界面上，不绕过任何风控。

---

## 安装

直接从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EagleClark/dsh-genshin-account
```

本地开发时也可以装成本地 link（改动即时生效）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <仓库绝对路径>
```

装完**重启 `dsh web`**（或重启 Desktop），刷新页面。之后侧边栏会多一个「原神账号」图标。

---

## 配置（在页面里做，不用改文件）

点侧边栏「原神账号」图标，第一次打开会直接落在 **设置** 页签。三步：

1. **填国服 UID** —— 服务器按 UID 自动判断（1/2 → 天空岛 `cn_gf01`，5 → 世界树 `cn_qd01`）。
2. **扫码登录** —— 点「生成二维码」，用**手机米游社 App** 扫码并在手机上确认。确认后插件从 `Set-Cookie` 拿到会话，不需要你复制任何 Cookie。
3. **安全验证** —— 点「开始验证」，在弹出的 geetest 滑块上拖一次。通过后插件自动换取 `x-rpc-challenge` 并立刻读取账号，成功即跳到概览。

   > 验证是**按接口**发放的：`/index`（账号概览）与 `/character/list`（角色详情）各要一次。所以可能连续弹两次滑块——第一次通过后如果角色详情仍被拦，页面会自动再弹第二次，不需要重新配置。

页面上还有 **接口诊断**：用当前会话依次打 `/index`、`/character/list`、`/character/detail`，逐个报告返回码——排查时比猜有用。

「高级设置」里可以改签名盐与 `app_version`（官方改版导致 `-10001` 时才需要）和缓存秒数。所有字段都是 `volatile`，保存后对下一次同步立即生效，无需重启。

配置文件仍落在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh-genshin-account` 行下的 `config:`），也可以直接改那里。会话 Cookie 只会存在本机，`/state` 接口从不回显它（只回 `hasCookie: true/false`）。

---

## GUI 用法

点侧边栏「原神账号」图标，五个页签：

- **概览** —— 昵称/冒险等级、角色/武器/圣遗物数量、元素分布、最佳圣遗物、数据来源与同步时间
- **角色** —— 左侧可搜索角色列表，右侧看等级、命座、三段天赋、面板、武器、五件圣遗物（主词条/副词条/CV/效率/评价）与**生效中的套装效果原文**
- **武器** —— 类型/稀有度/等级/精炼/装备角色
- **圣遗物** —— 按暴击值排序，含主副词条、评价、所属角色
- **设置** —— 上面的三步配置与接口诊断

右上角「同步」强制重新读取。会话或 `x-rpc-challenge` 过期时会重新要求扫码/验证，页面会直接说明。

---

## Agent 工具

装好后 agent 自动获得 5 个工具，你可以直接在对话里问，例如：

> 「我胡桃的圣遗物怎么样，哪件该换？」
> 「我这个号有多少五星武器？」
> 「列出所有火系角色」
> 「圣遗物里暴击值最高的 10 件」

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `genshin_account_overview` | 账号总览（数据源、数量、元素分布、最佳圣遗物）；`refresh:true` 强制同步 |
| `genshin_characters` | 角色列表，按元素/武器类型/最低等级过滤，按等级/稀有度/名字/圣遗物 CV 排序 |
| `genshin_character` | 单个角色完整练度（支持 中文名 / 英文名 / 别名 / 数字 id） |
| `genshin_artifacts` | 圣遗物筛选与排序（套装、部位、角色、最低 CV） |
| `genshin_weapons` | 武器筛选（类型、最低稀有度、是否已装备） |

工具返回结构化 JSON，同时渲染成给人看的文本；数据源不可用时返回**可读的错误**而不是抛异常，agent 会转告你该怎么配。

---

## 圣遗物评分怎么算

插件给每件圣遗物两个数，都可解释、都不假装是伤害计算：

- **CV（暴击值）** = `暴击率 × 2 + 暴击伤害`，只统计**副词条**。这是社区通用口径，与角色需求无关。
- **效率** = 每条副词条 `数值 ÷ 该词条 5★ 最高单次强化值`，求和后除以该圣遗物的强化位数（5★ +20 按 9 位，4★ +16 按 7 位）。100% = 每次强化都吃到最高档。
- **评价**（极品 / 优秀 / 可用 / 一般）由 CV 或效率任一达标决定。

这两项**不能替代**按角色配装的伤害模拟（元素精通、充能、特定套装 4 件套的价值因人而异）。插件会把套装 2/4 件套效果原文一起给出来，让 agent 结合角色判断。

---

## 随包数据与更新

`data/` 里是精简过的中文字典（离线可用，不依赖运行时网络）：

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `characters.json` | 124 个角色：中文名/英文名/元素/武器类型/稀有度/别名 |
| `weapons.json` | 255 把武器：中文名/类型/稀有度 |
| `artifact-sets.json` | 63 套圣遗物：中文名 + 2 件套 / 4 件套效果原文 |
| `aliases.json` | `"HuTao"` → `10000046` 这类 key 索引（大小写与标点无关） |
| `names-zh.json` | 接口返回的 hash/id → 中文名（含词条名） |
| `skill-orders.json` | 每个角色的「普攻/战技/爆发」技能 id 顺序 |

**为什么需要 `skill-orders.json`**：技能 id **不是**按 普攻→战技→爆发 递增的（神里绫华的普攻 id 比爆发 id 大），按 id 排序会把天赋等级张冠李戴。

重新生成（需要网络，仅开发时）：

```sh
node scripts/build-dict.mjs <genshin-db 路径>
node scripts/build-names.mjs
node scripts/build-skill-orders.mjs
```

游戏更新后角色/武器/圣遗物名字缺失时，重跑上面三条即可；插件本身不需要改代码。

---

## 工作原理

| 端 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| Host (`lib/index.js`) | 定义 Config；调度 `lib/sources/miyoushe.js`；把结果统一成一份 snapshot 后**内存 + 磁盘双缓存**（`$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-genshin-account/snapshot-miyoushe.json`），刷新失败时继续用上一份好数据；注册 5 个工具；用 `webServer` 挂同源 JSON 路由（`/state` `/summary` `/character` `/artifacts` `/weapons` `/sync` `/login/qr` `/login/poll` `/verify/start` `/verify/finish` `/probe-miyoushe` `/diag`） |
| `lib/sources/miyoushe.js` | DS2 签名、设备指纹（`x-rpc-device_fp`）、`x-rpc-challenge` 的持有与附加、`/index` + `/character/detail` 的抓取与解析 |
| `lib/sources/miyoushe-login.js` | 扫码登录：`createQRLogin` / `queryQRLoginStatus`，从 `Set-Cookie` 抽出会话 |
| `lib/model.js` | 解析名字/元素/部位、按 `location` 把武器与圣遗物挂回角色、排序与筛选、组装套装效果 |
| `lib/score.js` | CV / 效率 / 评价 |
| Client (`client/client.js`) | `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 包；`ctx.slots.inject` + 两次 `ctx.slots.register`（`main` 用 key `genshin`，`sidebar.panellist` 用同 id）——侧边栏按钮由 sidebar 自己渲染，插件只提供图标；样式全部走 `--dsw-*` 主题变量，自动跟随明暗主题 |

---

## 已知限制

- **需要登录态**：不带 Cookie 一律 `retcode 10001`，不存在按 UID 的匿名查询。
- **需要一次人机验证**：未通过时所有读取接口返回 `retcode 1034`；通过后 `x-rpc-challenge` 会持有到过期，届时再拖一次滑块即可。
- **只覆盖「角色详情已公开」的角色**：没公开的角色只有基础信息，读不到圣遗物词条。
- **接口是逆向接口**：签名盐与 `app_version` 会随官方改版失效（`-10001`），此时在高级设置里更新；频繁查询会被限流（`-110`/`1028`/`10101`）。
- CV / 效率是**通用质量指标**，不等于角色收益，更不是伤害计算。
- 4★ 圣遗物的强化位数按 7 位估算，与游戏内实际可能差一位。

---

## 验证状态

`npm test` 覆盖（全部通过）：

- `test/smoke-miyoushe.mjs` —— DS2 签名格式（三段、`t` 为秒、`r` 范围、md5）、`base` 嵌套、`skill_type`→天赋、`property_map`→词条、百分比/固定值区分、套装名解析
- `test/smoke-login.mjs` —— 扫码登录：`Set-Cookie` 解析（只留会话 cookie）、`createQr`（成功/被拒）、`pollQr` 全状态（Created / Scanned / Confirmed 带 Cookie / 无 Cookie 报错 / -3501 过期 / -3505 取消 / -3503 风控）
- `test/smoke-verify.mjs` —— 验证链路：`createVerification` 的参数与请求头、空任务报错、`verifyVerification` 换取并持有 `x-rpc-challenge`、该 token 会附到后续 record 请求、清空后不再附带
- `test/smoke-host.mjs` —— 5 个工具 + 12 条路由、`/state` 契约（含 Cookie 不回显）、缓存与 1034 降级、跨源 POST 拒绝、`/verify/*` 端到端（桩化 transport）
- `test/smoke-client.mjs` —— 按 web boot 协议加载浏览器 bundle：`main` + `sidebar.panellist` 注册、图标渲染、页面渲染不抛错、`configForms.get` 用 `include:<包名>`、页面读取的字段都存在 Host 返回的 JSON 里
- `test/render-check.mjs` / `test/mount-check.mjs` —— SSR 与 jsdom 挂载两条路径都能出界面

**未覆盖**：真实账号的滑块验证需要人手动拖一次，自动化测试里以桩化 transport 代替；`x-rpc-challenge` 的有效期以实际为准。

## 许可

MIT。随包游戏数据由 [genshin-db](https://github.com/theBowja/genshin-db)（MIT）与 [EnkaNetwork/API-docs](https://github.com/EnkaNetwork/API-docs) 生成，游戏名称与内容版权归米哈游所有。

# @asuna/agent-line Coding agents on this machine (Claude Code, or another) as an Asuna channel. Each agent has one direct line to her: a trusted home conversation, like the DSH peer line, that she can close herself. Who speaks is its own person (`agent:`), never the owner. The owner is a member of every line too (`OWNER_JOINS`): he writes there in the Web composer, as himself, with his own grants. Closing a line shuts out its agent, not the owner. The package only registers the kind (`agent`, `HOME`, `TEXT_ONLY`, `PEER_LINE`, `ROUTE_KEYS`, `OWNER_JOINS`, `MARKS_ANSWERS` with `answerer`). Nothing runs in the Host for it: the agent posts and polls through the channel API with `tools/agent_line.py`. ## Configuration (owner-local) Configure the channel in Asuna's settings like any other (`channels.agent`: `account_id`, token, one `dm` route per agent whose `sender_id` is the route name), with a `display_name` for each route: ```json "agent": { "account_id": "home", "token": "", "routes": { "claude-code": {"sender_id": "claude-code", "person_id": "agent:claude-code", "scene_id": "agent:home:dm:claude-code", "target": {"type": "dm", "id": "claude-code"}, "display_name": "Claude（开发助手）"} } } ``` Add `packages/channels/agent-line` to the profile's channel packages (`setup_native_profile.py --channel-package`). At start the host writes the route's key to `/private/route-keys/agent-.json`. ## Use ``` python tools/agent_line.py send claude-code "我是 Claude，……" python tools/agent_line.py send claude-code "改这一行就好" --answers q-1a2b3c4d python tools/agent_line.py poll claude-code --wait 120 python tools/agent_line.py status claude-code ``` `poll` prints what the owner wrote on that line since the last poll (marked as the owner's), then her answers on it, and confirms each answer; an answer nobody polls stays queued. The key opens only its own line: posting as that route, claiming and confirming her words there. Anything on the machine can read the key file, so the line's boundary is the machine; what it opens is one agent's voice in her home, never the owner's voice or chat. When she asks on a line with `ask` (`questions_from_program` shows the question's id), a message answers it only with `send --answers `; an agent's message without it answers nothing. A line the owner writes there from the Web (he cannot mark one) is still taken as the answer when it is the first after her question. The developer's line, where a `message_developer` call goes (it runs as `ask` on that line), is the route with `"developer": true`, else the route named `claude-code`.

Asuna Cognition Core

A framework for AI characters that live with you, on your own machine.

简体中文 · Running Asuna · Install

## What Asuna is Most chatbots wait to be spoken to, answer, and forget. Asuna is built for a character who *stays*: one with a home, a sense of time, people they know, memories they keep, and work they can actually get done. Asuna is the home; the character is a **persona package** you bring. The framework knows nothing about who lives in it. Personality, voice, and skills all come from the persona package, and a different package gives you a different character in the same home. Asuna also knows nothing about where the character meets people: each platform is a **channel package** you plug in. ## What a character can do **Think with two brains.** Every turn is led by the *character brain*: the part that is the character, that listens, feels, remembers, decides what to say, and says it. When something needs doing, such as looking things up, reading files, writing code, or checking a device, the character hands it to the *action brain*. It does the work with real tools in a sandbox and reports back, and the character decides what the result means. You can watch both brains side by side, each with its own colour: purple for the character, blue for the action. **Live at home, on their own rhythm.** The private chat with the owner is the character's home, not just an inbox. A heartbeat gives them time of their own: they can do nothing, follow up on something, or decide to drop by a group and start a topic. Each night they look back over the day and decide what is worth remembering for good. **Meet people where they are.** In group chats the character reads the room before speaking. They join in when called or when they have something to add, stay quiet when they don't, and get to know each person over time. **Keep memories of their own.** Characters write and revise their own notes and documents, keep a mood that carries from one conversation to the next, and recall what matters when it matters. Their inner state reaches them as words, not numbers, and they change it by choosing, not by typing values. **Grow by themselves.** A character keeps a notebook of things they'd like to improve, works on their own package in its own copy, and publishes the change only once it passes its checks and has been reviewed. **Stay trustworthy.** What a character shares with the owner stays private; groups only hear what is meant for them. Code runs in a sandbox, everything said on a platform goes through an audited outbox, and new abilities, a device on the home network for example, are granted one at a time when the character asks for them and says why. **Talk to other agents.** A *peer line* connects a character to an agent living in another DeepSeek Harness, such as an earlier version of the same character. The two can talk directly and hand knowledge over, and the line is the character's to open or close. ## What it looks like

The character brain (purple) hands a small task to the action brain (blue) with clear limits; the action brain reports what it found. The sidebar and names are blurred.

## How a moment flows ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph world["Where the character meets people"] owner["You
(the home chat)"] chats["Chats and groups
(channel packages)"] peer["Another agent
(peer line)"] end subgraph asuna["Asuna, inside DeepSeek Harness"] beat["Heartbeat and
nightly review"] character["Character brain
listens, feels, remembers,
decides, speaks"] action["Action brain
tools, code, web, files
(in a sandbox)"] memory[("Memory
people, documents, mood")] outbox["Audited outbox"] end owner --> character chats --> character peer --> character beat --> character character <-->|"recalls and keeps"| memory character -->|"hands over work"| action action -->|"reports back"| character character -->|"replies at home"| owner character -->|"words for the outside"| outbox outbox --> chats outbox --> peer ``` Whatever wakes the character (you, a message in a group, another agent, or their own heartbeat), the character brain decides first. Work goes to the action brain and comes back as a report. Words for the outside world leave only through the outbox, where each one is recorded. ## Built on DeepSeek Harness Asuna is a set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). DSH supplies the agent runtime and the web interface, and Asuna adds the character on top: the two brains, memory in MongoDB, the daily rhythm, and the channels. It reuses DSH's own interface instead of building another, so what you see is the regular DSH web page, with the character's conversations, the two brains' colours, and a memory panel added to it. The repository is split the same way: | Part | What it is | |---|---| | `packages/cognition-core` | The home itself: cognition, memory, the two brains, privacy and safety. It names no character and no platform. | | `packages/channels/napcat-qq` | A channel for QQ, through NapCat. | | `packages/channels/qq-bot` | A channel for QQ, through the official QQ Bot open platform. | | `packages/channels/dsh-peer` | A channel to an agent in another DeepSeek Harness (the peer line). | | `packages/personas/` | Persona packages: `ichinose-asuna`, `kyoyama-kazusa`, `shirase-shiori`, `xiaoman` and `yan-sui`. A persona package carries no channel configuration; any channel package works with any of them. | | `tests/fixtures/personas/demo` | A small synthetic persona, used by the tests and for trying things out. | | `deploy/docker` | A Docker stack that runs the same install on a Linux host. | ## Getting started You need DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, Python 3.12+, MongoDB with vector search, a model server for each brain (both brains may share one), and a persona package. Which models may run which brain, and the warnings about Claude models, are in [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md). Optional: NapCat for QQ. Commands run under DSH's own sandbox, on Windows, Linux or macOS. - **Installing the released plugins into DSH:** follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). It is written so a person or a coding agent can follow it. - **Running from this repository:** see [RUN_ASUNA.md](RUN_ASUNA.md). `start-asuna.cmd` (Windows) or `./start-asuna.sh` (Linux, macOS) opens the home; then visit the address it prints. For Docker, see [deploy/docker](deploy/docker/README.md). - **For developers and coding agents:** start with [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). [NATIVE_PLUGIN.md](NATIVE_PLUGIN.md) explains how the packages compose inside DSH and [RUNTIME_API.md](RUNTIME_API.md) describes the channel and tool contracts. Design decisions are kept in [docs/development_plans](docs/development_plans/README.md). ## License The core and the channel packages are licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0 only](LICENSE). Persona packages are not part of the release.

# @asuna/dsh-peer Another DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent as an Asuna channel. The peer lives in one session of another DSH Web server; she talks with it in one direct-message conversation of her own. - **Inbound:** the bridge follows that session (`session/follow` over `/api/remote.mux`). The peer's final reply of each completed turn becomes a direct message from the peer. - A turn answers her when its prompt is one she sent (DSH records it as `{kind: 'user', rpcId}`). A reply that did not answer her gets `ownerNote` as its first line and `raw.asuna_aside: true`: the host keeps it without waking her, and her home heartbeats and the plans due at home list it until she speaks on the line. - A new bridge starts from the session's present; it never replays history. - `occurred_at` uses the peer event's timestamp. A peer event without a timestamp omits it; forwarding time is not substituted. - **Outbound:** her words leave through the channel outbox. The bridge sends them as prompts to the session, with `label` as the first line and `replyNote` (her own words on how to answer her) before her text, and records the platform receipt (`platform_message_id` = the prompt's `requestId`). - **Scope:** only `session/follow` and `session/prompt`, only on the configured session. It is its own adapter: the bridge runs in this Host's plugin process (no sandboxed integration). It reaches the channel API through `ctx.asuna.channelEndpoint('dsh')`. It keeps its position in `/bridges/dsh-.json`. ## Configuration (owner-local) Configure the channel in Asuna's settings like any other (`channels.dsh`: `account_id`, token, one `dm` route whose `sender_id` is the peer). The scene id is `dsh::dm:` and the person is `dsh:`. Then configure this plugin's row in the profile's editable patch: ```yaml - id: asuna-dsh-peer name: '@asuna/dsh-peer' config: url: https://192.0.2.10 # the peer DSH Web server sessionId: session-… # the one session bridged routeId: peer-dm # the route in channels.dsh senderId: peer # that route's sender_id label: '[from …]' # who is speaking, first line of her messages there ownerNote: '(not a reply to you)' replyNote: '(how she asks to be answered)' # opens every message of hers; her words insecureTls: true # a LAN service behind its own local CA closedUntil: '2026-01-01T09:00:00+13:00' # optional: line closed until then, reopens by itself ``` Without `url`, `sessionId`, `routeId` and `senderId` the bridge stays idle. While `closedUntil` lies ahead, the peer's replies are passed over (not delivered later) and her words wait in the outbox; the line reopens by itself.

Asuna Cognition Core

A framework for AI characters that live with you, on your own machine.

简体中文 · Running Asuna · Install

## What Asuna is Most chatbots wait to be spoken to, answer, and forget. Asuna is built for a character who *stays*: one with a home, a sense of time, people they know, memories they keep, and work they can actually get done. Asuna is the home; the character is a **persona package** you bring. The framework knows nothing about who lives in it. Personality, voice, and skills all come from the persona package, and a different package gives you a different character in the same home. Asuna also knows nothing about where the character meets people: each platform is a **channel package** you plug in. ## What a character can do **Think with two brains.** Every turn is led by the *character brain*: the part that is the character, that listens, feels, remembers, decides what to say, and says it. When something needs doing, such as looking things up, reading files, writing code, or checking a device, the character hands it to the *action brain*. It does the work with real tools in a sandbox and reports back, and the character decides what the result means. You can watch both brains side by side, each with its own colour: purple for the character, blue for the action. **Live at home, on their own rhythm.** The private chat with the owner is the character's home, not just an inbox. A heartbeat gives them time of their own: they can do nothing, follow up on something, or decide to drop by a group and start a topic. Each night they look back over the day and decide what is worth remembering for good. **Meet people where they are.** In group chats the character reads the room before speaking. They join in when called or when they have something to add, stay quiet when they don't, and get to know each person over time. **Keep memories of their own.** Characters write and revise their own notes and documents, keep a mood that carries from one conversation to the next, and recall what matters when it matters. Their inner state reaches them as words, not numbers, and they change it by choosing, not by typing values. **Grow by themselves.** A character keeps a notebook of things they'd like to improve, works on their own package in its own copy, and publishes the change only once it passes its checks and has been reviewed. **Stay trustworthy.** What a character shares with the owner stays private; groups only hear what is meant for them. Code runs in a sandbox, everything said on a platform goes through an audited outbox, and new abilities, a device on the home network for example, are granted one at a time when the character asks for them and says why. **Talk to other agents.** A *peer line* connects a character to an agent living in another DeepSeek Harness, such as an earlier version of the same character. The two can talk directly and hand knowledge over, and the line is the character's to open or close. ## What it looks like

The character brain (purple) hands a small task to the action brain (blue) with clear limits; the action brain reports what it found. The sidebar and names are blurred.

## How a moment flows ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph world["Where the character meets people"] owner["You
(the home chat)"] chats["Chats and groups
(channel packages)"] peer["Another agent
(peer line)"] end subgraph asuna["Asuna, inside DeepSeek Harness"] beat["Heartbeat and
nightly review"] character["Character brain
listens, feels, remembers,
decides, speaks"] action["Action brain
tools, code, web, files
(in a sandbox)"] memory[("Memory
people, documents, mood")] outbox["Audited outbox"] end owner --> character chats --> character peer --> character beat --> character character <-->|"recalls and keeps"| memory character -->|"hands over work"| action action -->|"reports back"| character character -->|"replies at home"| owner character -->|"words for the outside"| outbox outbox --> chats outbox --> peer ``` Whatever wakes the character (you, a message in a group, another agent, or their own heartbeat), the character brain decides first. Work goes to the action brain and comes back as a report. Words for the outside world leave only through the outbox, where each one is recorded. ## Built on DeepSeek Harness Asuna is a set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). DSH supplies the agent runtime and the web interface, and Asuna adds the character on top: the two brains, memory in MongoDB, the daily rhythm, and the channels. It reuses DSH's own interface instead of building another, so what you see is the regular DSH web page, with the character's conversations, the two brains' colours, and a memory panel added to it. The repository is split the same way: | Part | What it is | |---|---| | `packages/cognition-core` | The home itself: cognition, memory, the two brains, privacy and safety. It names no character and no platform. | | `packages/channels/napcat-qq` | A channel for QQ, through NapCat. | | `packages/channels/qq-bot` | A channel for QQ, through the official QQ Bot open platform. | | `packages/channels/dsh-peer` | A channel to an agent in another DeepSeek Harness (the peer line). | | `packages/personas/` | Persona packages: `ichinose-asuna`, `kyoyama-kazusa`, `shirase-shiori`, `xiaoman` and `yan-sui`. A persona package carries no channel configuration; any channel package works with any of them. | | `tests/fixtures/personas/demo` | A small synthetic persona, used by the tests and for trying things out. | | `deploy/docker` | A Docker stack that runs the same install on a Linux host. | ## Getting started You need DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, Python 3.12+, MongoDB with vector search, a model server for each brain (both brains may share one), and a persona package. Which models may run which brain, and the warnings about Claude models, are in [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md). Optional: NapCat for QQ. Commands run under DSH's own sandbox, on Windows, Linux or macOS. - **Installing the released plugins into DSH:** follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). It is written so a person or a coding agent can follow it. - **Running from this repository:** see [RUN_ASUNA.md](RUN_ASUNA.md). `start-asuna.cmd` (Windows) or `./start-asuna.sh` (Linux, macOS) opens the home; then visit the address it prints. For Docker, see [deploy/docker](deploy/docker/README.md). - **For developers and coding agents:** start with [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). [NATIVE_PLUGIN.md](NATIVE_PLUGIN.md) explains how the packages compose inside DSH and [RUNTIME_API.md](RUNTIME_API.md) describes the channel and tool contracts. Design decisions are kept in [docs/development_plans](docs/development_plans/README.md). ## License The core and the channel packages are licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0 only](LICENSE). Persona packages are not part of the release.
