# Error Knowledge Base

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [License](LICENSE)

> **Recycles errors: the same failure is diagnosed once, recorded, and handed back as a known fix the next time it appears — locally, without calling a model.**

**Status: v0.1.0 (2026-10-21).** Windows desktop build with a local PostgreSQL 16 knowledge base, measured against DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, Codex CLI 0.156.1 and Claude Code 2.1.282. The clean-VM acceptance is **blocked** and recorded in [`docs/acceptance-vm.md`](docs/acceptance-vm.md); the release pipeline refuses to publish a version without that record.

The **Error Knowledge Base** (`error-knowledge-base`) is one product in several shapes: a command-line client, a local background daemon, an MCP stdio server, a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin, and host connectors for Codex CLI and Claude Code. Every shape talks to the same local core and the same knowledge base: the classification, redaction, normalisation, fingerprinting, storage, retrieval and fix-trust logic lives in the core and is not reimplemented per host. The repository is still named `dsh-errkb` and the command is `errkb`; both keep working.

## Contents

- [What the Error Knowledge Base is](#what-the-error-knowledge-base-is)
- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Supported hosts (measured)](#supported-hosts-measured)
- [What the core guarantees](#what-the-core-guarantees)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Command line](#command-line)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Compatibility and version caliber](#compatibility-and-version-caliber)
- [Installing and uninstalling](#installing-and-uninstalling)
- [Privacy](#privacy)
- [Documentation](#documentation)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Development](#development)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## What the Error Knowledge Base is

A local error knowledge base for LLM tools and command-line workflows. When something fails, it records the failure once — redacted, normalised and fingerprinted — in a local PostgreSQL database. The next time the same failure appears, it hands back the recorded fix, with the match reason, the applicability warning when the environment differs, and the fix's measured trust.

It is deliberately **not**:

- **A chat model.** The core never calls a model and never uses the network. Connectors observe what the host already produced; the fix either already exists in the database or is written by the user.
- **A log archive.** Only failures that earn an ID are stored, with bounded samples; retention is explicit.
- **A cloud service.** There is no account, no telemetry and no remote endpoint. HTTP off by default; the local API is a Named Pipe.
- **A drop-in binary with an embedded database.** The knowledge base is PostgreSQL, a runtime prerequisite (see [Requirements](#requirements)); the Windows installer creates and manages a dedicated cluster.

## How it works

```text
host event ──▶ adapter ──▶ redact ──▶ normalise ──▶ fingerprint ──▶ PostgreSQL
   (hook, wrapper, MCP)         (before any write)                   │
                                                                    ▼
fix + reason + trust ◀── exact match first, approximate top 3 ◀──── retrieval
```

1. **Capture.** A connector turns an observable failure into an `ErrorEvent v1` payload: structured fields where the host reports them (exit code, command, tool name, session), derived fields otherwise (headline, category, severity).
2. **Redact before write.** Secrets, credentials, e-mail addresses and absolute home paths are replaced with placeholders by one rule source (`spec/redact.cue`), generated into the Go engine, the TypeScript adapter and the CI privacy guard.
3. **Normalise and fingerprint.** ANSI escapes, GUIDs, timestamps, PIDs, counters, ports and absolute paths are removed; the remaining text is lower-cased and hashed as `sha256(category + "\0" + normalised)[:12]`. The same failure yields the same 12-hex fingerprint; different failures do not.
4. **Store.** Issues (one per fingerprint and project), occurrences, immutable events, solution versions and outcomes land in PostgreSQL. Schema migrations run in one transaction each, with an advisory lock and a checksum ledger.
5. **Retrieve and hand back.** Exact lookups by issue id, fingerprint, error code or command run first. Fuzzy candidates come from `pg_trgm`, are re-ranked with Jaccard similarity, and are always capped at three and **marked approximate**. The result carries the match reason, the environment difference when one exists, and the fix's trust; approximate matches are never auto-reused.

The full design is in [`docs/implementation-plan.md`](docs/implementation-plan.md).

## Supported hosts (measured)

Measured on 2026-10-20; versions are pinned on purpose. Each row maps to a real acceptance record, and anything not measured is listed as unverified in [`docs/connector-matrix.md`](docs/connector-matrix.md).

| Host | Measured version | Channel | Known fix before diagnosis | Acceptance record |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Generic CLI (`errkb run --`) | errkb from this tree | **B** wrapper | No — after the failure | [`docs/e2e-cli-loop.md`](docs/e2e-cli-loop.md) |
| DSH (plugin adapter) | DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 | **A** plugin hooks | Yes — standing hint and post-execute notices | EKB-039, PR #66 |
| Codex CLI | 0.156.1 | **B** wrapper; **MCP** eight tools | No — MCP tools are available, but no pre-failure hook | [`connectors/codex/probe.md`](connectors/codex/probe.md) |
| Claude Code | 2.1.282 | **A** `PostToolUseFailure` hook; **B** wrapper; **MCP** | Yes — `SessionStart` hint and MCP tools | [`connectors/claude/probe.md`](connectors/claude/probe.md) |

Generic log and manual hosts use the template in [`connectors/templates/cli-log/`](connectors/templates/cli-log/README.md); their log channel and manual channel are not yet measured live. A window title is not an interface contract, so no support claim here rests on one.

## What the core guarantees

- **Exact before fuzzy.** The retrieval gate asks for one whole value — issue id, fingerprint, error code, normalised message, command or tool name — and only then widens.
- **No false auto-merge.** A match is auto-reusable only when it is an exact fingerprint match and the code, command and tool do not contradict. The labelled corpus (`spec/corpus/labelled/`) contains lookalikes that a naive matcher merges; the test asserts zero false auto-merges.
- **Approximate matches are visible.** The UI prints `APPROXIMATE — confirm before reuse`; notices carry the badge and the environment warning; MCP and CLI JSON carry `approximate: true`.
- **Top three, with reasons.** Retrieval returns at most three candidates, each with the match reason and the fields that matched.
- **Latency has a gate, not an aspiration.** On the reference machine at 100,000 issues: exact p95 0.6 ms, trigram candidates p95 81.7 ms, full retrieval p95 84.5 ms (gate: 150 ms). Environment, dataset and plans are in [`docs/benchmarks.md`](docs/benchmarks.md).
- **Trust is computed, not asserted.** `errkb_trust()` = `(successes + 2) / (successes + failures + 4)`, computed in SQL from recorded outcomes; unknown outcomes are excluded. The UI displays it and cannot write it.
- **Writes are idempotent.** Events are unique by `event_id`; connector observations carry an `observation_id`; replays do not create duplicates, and occurrences are always appended.
- **Nothing crashes the product.** The daemon is single-instance per Windows session, shuts down gracefully, writes a health document, and keeps a redacted rotating log. A crash during a write, a batch or a migration leaves committed data intact (verified by killing real processes in the test suite).

## Quick start

> The installed first-run path is **not complete in 0.1.0**: the installer creates the PostgreSQL cluster but does not apply the schema, and the CLI has no `db migrate` command yet. See [Known limitations](#known-limitations). Until a follow-up card closes that gap, the supported route is the development/rehearsal path recorded in [`docs/acceptance-vm.md`](docs/acceptance-vm.md).

1. **Install PostgreSQL 16** (EDB installer, or let the errkb installer create a dedicated cluster on port 5433). Record the DSN.
2. **Get the schema in place** on that database. In 0.1.0 this is done with the Go migrator (the same path the tests and the rehearsal use).
3. **Build and start the daemon:**

   ```powershell
   go build -o errkb.exe ./cmd/errkb
   .\errkb.exe daemon --dsn "postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/errkb?sslmode=disable"
   ```

4. **Capture a real failure** through the wrapper:

   ```powershell
   .\errkb.exe run --connector cli --session demo --project demo -- cmd /c "exit 9"
   ```

5. **Record the fix** — through the MCP server (`err_record_solution`), the DSH plugin, or the editor UI model — then run the same command again; the wrapper prints the known fix, its source and its trust.

The full loop, including the recorded output, is in [`docs/e2e-cli-loop.md`](docs/e2e-cli-loop.md).

## Command line

One binary, several subcommands:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `errkb search <query>` | Search by issue id, fingerprint, error code, command or text; human table or `--json` |
| `errkb show <id-or-fingerprint>` | One issue with occurrences, solutions and versions |
| `errkb record --event <file>` | Record a complete `ErrorEvent v1` payload (from stdin or a file) |
| `errkb list --kind issue\|solution` | List issues or solutions, filterable by project |
| `errkb feedback <issue> <version> --outcome success\|failure\|unknown` | Record an outcome; this is what moves trust |
| `errkb stats` | Counts, hit rate, latency percentiles and estimated savings |
| `errkb run -- <command>` | Run a command, keep its output visible, record failures only |
| `errkb daemon` | Local background service: Named Pipe API, health document, redacted log |
| `errkb ui` | Tray icon and search window wired to the daemon |
| `errkb doctor` | Eight read-only environment and connector checks, with a fix per finding |
| `errkb mcp` | MCP stdio server with eight tools |
| `errkb version` | Version, commit, build time and Go toolchain |

Exit codes: `0` found/success, `1` internal error, `2` bad arguments, `3` not found, `4` daemon unavailable. `--json` output is the validated contract payload, not a re-rendered approximation.

## Configuration

Configuration is a YAML document validated against one contract (`spec/config.cue`):

```yaml
database:
  dsn: postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/errkb?sslmode=disable
service:
  pipe:
    enabled: true
  http:
    enabled: false        # loopback-only when enabled, token at least 32 characters
capture:
  enabled: true
retention:
  sample_days: 7
  normalized_days: 90
  audit_days: 365
```

Defaults: Named Pipe on, HTTP off, capture on, notices on, search limit 3, capture/search/MCP timeouts 2000/1500/5000 ms. The daemon also takes explicit flags (`--dsn`, `--pipe`, `--health-file`, `--log-file`, …); the settings page model edits the same file without introducing a second configuration model. A full example ships in [`connectors/templates/cli-log/config.yaml`](connectors/templates/cli-log/config.yaml).

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11, x64.** The daemon, tray, Named Pipe API and Windows connector service are Windows-specific.
- **PostgreSQL 16** (server). Not bundled; the installer can create a dedicated cluster on port 5433. A running local instance can be reused instead.
- **No Go, Node.js or development toolchain at runtime.** The release binary and the installer are self-contained apart from PostgreSQL.
- Development only: Go 1.26.4, Node.js 24.16.0 with pnpm 11.7.0, CUE 0.17.1, Inno Setup 6 for the installer, and a local PostgreSQL for the database tests.

## Compatibility and version caliber

- **Schema.** v1, migrations `0001`–`0008`. Upgrades from older schemas are tested against real snapshots in `db/migrations/testdata/upgrade/`; a newer ledger version is refused explicitly, and a failed migration rolls back in one transaction.
- **Contracts.** CUE definitions for `ErrorEvent v1`, config, connector capability, MCP tools, the local API, the connector SDK and the redaction rules. Compatibility is enforced by `spec/compat.cue` and the `Schema compatibility` CI job: additive optional fields and new enum members are compatible; removing, renaming or re-typing a field requires a `schema_version` bump, and a broken rule fails the job.
- **DSH packages.** The plugin builds against `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` **0.1.5-rc.3** as resolved by the lockfile, and a DSH host in the **0.2.x** generation (0.2.0-rc.2 measured; the plan records `dsh-ops`'s peer range as the version evidence). The earlier rc.2 statement was a historical design-time caliber: the peer range `^0.1.5-rc.2` covers rc.3, and the API surface the adapter uses did not change. The full explanation is plan §7.2.
- **Protocols.** MCP `2024-11-05`; local API and connector SDK envelopes are `v1`. Unknown fields are rejected on decoded payloads, and a payload declaring a newer version is refused rather than guessed.

## Installing and uninstalling

The Windows installer (`errkb-<version>-setup.exe`) installs per user into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\errkb`, creates a dedicated PostgreSQL cluster on port 5433 (or reuses an existing instance / a chosen port), and offers to start it. Uninstalling asks **keep data** or **delete data**; the cluster password lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\errkb\pg\credentials.json` with owner-only ACLs.

Full steps, data locations, silent-install behavior and the current first-run gap are in [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md). The clean-VM acceptance is blocked; its findings and harness are in [`docs/acceptance-vm.md`](docs/acceptance-vm.md). The release is not code-signed; verify artifacts against `SHA256SUMS` in the release bundle.

## Privacy

Everything stays on the machine. The core never calls a model and never uses the network; the local API is a Named Pipe with an owner-only ACL, HTTP is off by default, and redaction happens **before** anything is written to the knowledge base. Retention periods, scoped deletion with a preview and an audit trail, and what the adapter's offline queue keeps are described in [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md).

## Documentation

| Document | What it answers |
| --- | --- |
| [`docs/implementation-plan.md`](docs/implementation-plan.md) / [中文](docs/implementation-plan.zh-CN.md) | The single source of truth: scope, decisions, task cards, acceptance gates |
| [`docs/connector-matrix.md`](docs/connector-matrix.md) / [中文](docs/connector-matrix.zh-CN.md) | Which host reports which field, measured with pinned versions |
| [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) | Install, data locations, upgrade, uninstall |
| [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) | Data flow, redaction, retention, deletion |
| [`docs/benchmarks.md`](docs/benchmarks.md) | Performance gate, dataset, plans, environment |
| [`docs/acceptance-vm.md`](docs/acceptance-vm.md) | Clean-VM acceptance results and current blockers |
| [`docs/e2e-cli-loop.md`](docs/e2e-cli-loop.md) | The generic CLI loop, end to end, without a model |
| [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) | What changed in each release |
| [`packaging/windows/`](packaging/windows) | Build, release and installer scripts |

## Known limitations

These are recorded in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) and tracked by the plan; they are not hidden.

- **No first-run schema on a fresh install.** The installer creates the cluster but applies no migrations, and `errkb` has no `db migrate` subcommand yet; the daemon refuses to start until the ledger exists.
- **Nothing restarts after a reboot.** The cluster is not registered as a Windows service and there is no daemon/tray autostart yet.
- **The release is not code-signed.** SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS`.
- **PostgreSQL is a prerequisite.** The core needs a local PostgreSQL 16 server; the installer creates one, but the database is not embedded in the application.
- **Some UI screens are models only.** The tray and the search window are wired to the running daemon; issue detail, settings and statistics exist as tested models whose windows are not hooked up yet.
- **`errkb run -- <command>` without options before `--`** reports that the command must follow `--` even though it does. Pass `--connector` and `--session` first, as the adapters do.
- **The DSH plugin is pending store review.** Installing it by hand is the supported path for now.
- **Two measured gaps in the connector matrix:** the DSH `tools/result` live path and the Codex `PostToolUse` hook are unverified.

## Development

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck     # tsc --noEmit
pnpm lint          # oxlint
pnpm format:check  # prettier
pnpm test          # vitest with the 99% coverage gate
pnpm build         # the DSH connector bundle in lib/

go build ./...
go vet ./...
gofmt -l .
cue vet ./spec/...
```

Database tests need a local PostgreSQL and `ERRKB_TEST_DATABASE_URL`; without it they skip. The build, release and installer scripts are in [`packaging/windows/`](packaging/windows), the task-by-task order is plan §11.1, and the repository conventions (one card per PR, both languages change together) are in the plan.

## Contributing

Read the implementation plan first; work happens card by card (`EKB-nnn`), one pull request per card, with the gates from the plan's §12. Keep the two plan languages and the two README languages in step. Security or privacy issues belong in an issue that names the affected file, not in a public fix commit.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © jingchangzhao-gif

# dsh-molecule-visualization

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

> 本仓库基于 [PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer](https://github.com/PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer)（MIT 许可）改写，独立演进。
> 上游实现了 DSH 插槽接入、3Dmol.js 本地打包与基础查看器；在此基础上修掉了 6 个已复现的渲染问题，
> 并新增 XYZ / Gaussian 输入支持、球棍样式、卡片级错误原因与布局超时保护。
> 包名是 **`dsh-molecule-visualization`**（上游叫 `dsh-molecule-viewer`；工具名仍是 `view_molecule`）。
> **改动清单**见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)（逐项）与 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)；上游版权声明与 MIT 许可完整保留，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）分子可视化插件：传入分子文件路径或 PDB/SDF/MOL/MOL2/XYZ/GJF 格式数据，
在会话界面渲染**交互式 3D 分子查看器**（3Dmol.js，支持旋转/缩放/样式切换/着色）。

## 相对上游 0.2.0 修复的问题

| # | 问题 | 上游症状 | 本仓库的处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mol` 格式被静默丢弃 | 工具声明支持 `mol`，但格式被原样传给 `addModel`。3Dmol.js 2.4.2 **没有** `mol` 解析器，会打印 `Unknown format: mol` 并按文本猜格式；真实 molfile 多数会被猜成 `xyz` → **解析出 0 个原子、外框正常、分子不显示、无报错**（实测 14 个真实 `.mol` 里 12 个渲染 0 原子） | 输入 `mol` 内部映射为 `sdf` 解析器；载荷里带 `renderFormat` 字段，客户端也会兜底映射（旧会话记录同样能修好） |
| 2 | 失败对用户不可见 | 解析失败/空模型只留下空白 canvas | 卡片上显示**具体原因 + 修复建议 + 重试按钮**：解析异常、0 原子、WebGL 不可用、容器不可见各有独立文案；渲染后还会核对「host 统计原子数 vs 3Dmol 实际载入数」 |
| 3 | 缺少球棍样式 | 只有 stick/line/sphere/cartoon | 新增 `ballstick`：`{ stick: { radius: 0.15 }, sphere: { scale: 0.25 } }` 两种表示叠加（3Dmol 没有原生球棍表示） |
| 4 | 无键模型什么都画不出来 | stick 靠键绘制；无键表（XYZ、空 bond 块）→ 空画面 | 载入后若键数为 0，先 `model.assignBonds()` 按距离推断；仍为 0 则降级为球状显示并在卡片上说明（不会空白） |
| 5 | 布局等待可能永久挂起 | `awaitLayoutBox()` 等待非零尺寸，祖先被折叠/隐藏时永不 resolve → 永远 "Loading 3D viewer…" | 加 10 秒超时，超时后显示「容器不可见」+ 原因（`display:none` / 0×0）+ 重试按钮 |
| 6 | 格式校验太松 | PDB 固定列错位仍被接受，3Dmol.js 静默丢原子（实测一份 Chem3D 导出的 PDB：host 数到 92 个原子，画面只有 1 个） | host 侧按 PDB 规范逐列校验（记录名 1-6、x 31-38、y 39-46、z 47-54、resName 18-20、第 30 列必须为空）；识别「整份文件统一 altLoc」这一列错位特征并**修复列 17**（修复会以警告写进卡片），也可用 `repairShiftedPdbAltLoc: false` 关闭改为直接报错 |

> 实测细节（含未复现项）见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。简言之：问题 1、2、5、6 全部复现；
> 问题 3 是功能缺失（确认）；**问题 4 的描述与 2.4.2 的实际行为不符**——3Dmol.js 对无 CONECT 的 PDB
> 已按距离补键（1CRN 去掉 CONECT 仍有 334 根键）。因此本仓库仍做了「无键 → 推断 → 球状降级」的兜底，
> 但它是防御性的，而不是在修一个能复现的空白画面。

## 特性

- 🧬 **六种格式**：PDB、SDF、MOL、MOL2、XYZ，以及 Gaussian 输入（`.gjf` / `.com`，只取几何结构）
- 🧱 **PDB 列校验 + 自动修复**：错位/截断/非数字坐标直接给出「哪一行、哪一列」；整份文件统一的 altLoc 伪标记会被修复并提示
- 📁 **路径优先**：直接传文件路径，服务端读取——Windows（`D:\dir\x.pdb`）、WSL（`/mnt/d/dir/x.pdb`）与 `~/` 自动互转
- 🖱️ **交互式查看器**：旋转、缩放，实时切换 **ball & stick** / stick / line / sphere / cartoon，背景色与分子着色
- 🔄 **重启可恢复**：载荷随 `tool/result` 事件持久化（`presentationMeta`），重启后照常渲染，无需自定义事件类型
- ⚠️ **失败可见**：空白 canvas 不再可能——每类失败都有具体原因、建议与重试
- ⏱️ **超时保护**：容器不可见时 10 秒后给出提示，而不是永久 Loading
- ⤢ **可放大到整个窗口**：卡片内是紧凑视图（高度随窗口自适应，不再写死 400px），点右上角「放大」用浮层铺满窗口，Esc 或点遮罩收起
- 📦 **本地打包 3Dmol.js**：`vendor/3Dmol-min.cjs`（2.4.2）构建时打进 client bundle——无 CDN 运行时请求，可离线
- 🔍 **可验证**：`node scripts/verify.mjs` 一条命令跑完类型检查、98 个测试（含 3 个 jsdom 渲染测试）、
  3Dmol 解析探针、真实文件端到端探针与构建产物冒烟测试

## 安装

### 方式 A：从 GitHub 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Kanade-Tachibana-Methyl/dsh-molecule-visualization.git
```

也可以直接用源码安装形式（不需要 npm 包）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kanade-Tachibana-Methyl/dsh-molecule-visualization
```

> GitHub 访问不稳定时，可换成 SSH 形式：
> `dsh plugin --profile web add git+ssh://git@github.com/Kanade-Tachibana-Methyl/dsh-molecule-visualization.git`

### 方式 B：本地目录（开发/自用）

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs                                  # 产出 lib/index.js + lib/client.js
dsh plugin --profile web add file:<path-to-repo>
```

`dsh plugin` 是 pnpm 转发器：检测到 `dsh.bundle.patch` 会把它加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
若 profile 里已装过同功能插件（例如上游 `dsh-molecule-viewer`），先移除再用本包，
否则两个插件会各自注册一次 `view_molecule`。

### 方式 C：手工覆盖 profile 里的目录

```powershell
$dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-molecule-visualization"
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force "<path-to-repo>\*" $dst   # 先备份
```

### 生效范围

- **client 半边**（渲染器）：DSH 的 `client-hmr` 每 500 ms 轮询 bundle 文件，检测到变化就推送新 rev 并热替换——
  **刷新页面即可，不必重启进程**。
- **host 半边**（`view_molecule` 工具注册、格式枚举、校验）：需要重启 DSH 进程：

```bash
dsh --profile web
```

## 使用

对话中描述需求即可，模型会自动调用：

> "帮我可视化这个分子：D:\project\Dock\data\3IPQ.pdb"

### 支持的格式

| 格式 | 扩展名 | 渲染用解析器 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| PDB | `.pdb` `.ent` | `pdb` | 蛋白质/大分子（ATOM/HETATM 记录）；`keepH` 保证氢原子不被丢弃 |
| SDF | `.sdf` `.sd` | `sdf` | 多分子结构（V2000/V3000）；多分子文件只渲染第一条并提示 |
| MOL | `.mol` | **`sdf`** | MDL MOL（V2000/V3000）——3Dmol.js 没有 `mol` 解析器 |
| MOL2 | `.mol2` | `mol2` | TRIPOS 格式 |
| XYZ | `.xyz` | `xyz` | 无键表，载入后按距离感知成键 |
| GJF | `.gjf` `.com` | **`xyz`** | Gaussian 输入文件，host 侧把几何块转成 XYZ（忽略路由段/Link1/ECP） |

> SMILES 不支持——必须有 3D 坐标（与上游一致）。
>
> 超过 2 MB 的分子内容不会内联进会话日志，查看器位置显示摘要卡片（原子数与格式仍可见）。

### 渲染样式

| 样式 | 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `ballstick` | 球棍 | 细棒 + 小球叠加（`stick.radius 0.15`、`sphere.scale 0.25`）——小分子推荐；默认仍是 `stick` |
| `stick` | 棒状 | 只有化学键 |
| `line` | 线框 | 最轻 |
| `sphere` | 空间填充 | 范德华半径 |
| `cartoon` | 飘带 | 蛋白二级结构；配体/小分子自动改用棒状以免看不见 |

### 工具参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | 与 `data` 二选一（**优先**） | 分子文件路径，按你的原始写法传入（Windows/WSL 双向兼容，`~/` 自动展开） |
| `data` | `string` | 与 `path` 二选一 | 分子文件纯文本内容——仅用于磁盘上没有文件的情况，不要 base64 |
| `format` | `pdb \| sdf \| mol2 \| mol \| xyz \| gjf` | 传 `data` 时必填 | 传 `path` 时按扩展名推断，可省略 |
| `name` | `string` | 否 | 显示名称，作为查看器标题 |
| `style` | `stick \| ballstick \| line \| sphere \| cartoon` | 否 | 初始样式（默认 `stick`；蛋白质建议 `cartoon`） |

### 插件配置

```yaml
- id: molecule-visualization
  name: 'dsh-molecule-visualization'
  config:
    defaultStyle: stick              # 默认初始样式；小分子可改 ballstick
    repairShiftedPdbAltLoc: true     # PDB 列错位（统一 altLoc）自动修复；false = 直接报错
```

### 卡片上会看到什么

| 情况 | 卡片表现 |
|---|---|
| 正常 | 3D 视图 + 样式/背景/着色控件；有警告时底部显示 ⚠ 提示条 |
| host 校验失败（列错位、截断、格式不符） | 红色标题「无法显示这份 PDB 结构（文件名）：具体原因」+ 修复建议 + 校验警告 |
| 3Dmol.js 解析出 0 原子 | 「3Dmol.js 没有读出原子：…（host 侧统计到 N 个）」+ 建议 |
| host / 渲染原子数不符 | 视图照常渲染 + 提示「只载入了 45/92 个原子」 |
| 容器被折叠/隐藏 | 10 秒后「容器不可见，渲染超时：原因」+ 重试 |
| WebGL 不可用 | 「WebGL 不可用：…」+ 建议检查浏览器 GPU 设置 |
| 想细看 / 卡片太矮 | 点右上角「⤢ 放大」：浮层里用整个窗口渲染，Esc 或点遮罩关闭；会话里留一行「收起放大视图」的入口 |

## 仓库规范（dsh-plugin）

本仓库按 DSH 插件的公开约定组织，`dsh plugin` / 插件清单可以直接识别：

| 约定 | 本仓库的取值 |
|---|---|
| 仓库名 = 包名 | `dsh-molecule-visualization`（GitHub 仓库与 `package.json.name` 一致） |
| 工具名保持稳定 | 仍为 `view_molecule`（改名会破坏已有提示词与历史调用） |
| `dsh.manifestVersion` | `1` |
| `dsh.bundle.patch` | `./cordis.patch.yml`（一行 `insert`，id `molecule-visualization`） |
| `dsh.client.platform` | `web` |
| `dsh.client.inject` | `["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool"]`（`tool.call.toolview` 槽位的属主） |
| `icon` | `./assets/icon.svg`（插件清单里显示） |
| `engines` | `node >=22`、`dsh >=0.2.0-rc.2` |
| `keywords` | 含 `dsh-plugin`、`deepseek-harness`、`3dmol`、`molecule-visualization` 等 |
| GitHub topics | `dsh-plugin`、`deepseek-harness`、`dsh`、`molecule-visualization`、`molecular-visualization`、`3dmol`、`pdb`、`sdf`、`chemistry`、`webgl` |

发布流程、仓库元数据与 Release 文案见 [docs/release-checklist.md](docs/release-checklist.md)。

## 验证

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs                # 类型检查 + 测试 + 探针
node scripts/verify.mjs <path-to-molecular-files>   # 额外对指定目录下的真实文件跑端到端探针
```

6 条验收清单的实测结果见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。

## 开发

```bash
npm install                 # .npmrc 里 legacy-peer-deps=true（@deepseek-ai/* 不在 npm 上）
node scripts/build.mjs      # host: tsc → lib/，client: esbuild → lib/client.js
node scripts/typecheck.mjs  # 两个 tsconfig 都跑
node test/run-all.ts        # 单进程跑全部测试
node scripts/verify.mjs     # 全部验证
```

类型检查需要 DSH 的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包（npm 上没有）：把它们链接进 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai`：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai `
  -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
```

运行时不需要这个链接——插件装进 profile 后从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析。

## License 与归属

- **MIT**，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)：上游版权声明 `Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-molecule-viewer contributors` 完整保留，
  并新增本仓库的版权行 `Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-molecule-visualization contributors`。
- 上游：[PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer](https://github.com/PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer)。
- 本仓库不是"从零实现"：插槽接入（`tool.call.toolview`）、`presentationMeta` 载荷设计、
  3Dmol.js 本地打包（`vendor/3Dmol-min.cjs`）与查看器 UI 骨架均来自上游；改动逐项列在
  [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)，版本差异见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- 3Dmol.js 本身也是 MIT（其许可与版权见 [vendor/](vendor/) 与上游发行包）。

# dsh-engram · 记忆宫殿

DeepSeek Harness 跨会话长期记忆插件 — 把记忆宫殿的信息架构（而不是它的神经科学隐喻）真正落进 agent：位置当索引（每条记忆钉在「房间#桩位」坐标上）、固定路线定顺序（巡游路线只增不改）、骨架长期复用（同主题永远同房同序）、标记独一无二（门牌纪律：唯一 · 差异化 · 带日期）。配套间隔重复的检索练习（只给线索、不给正文）与知识飞轮（摄取 → 强化 → 蒸馏 → 衰减）。纯 TypeScript，零外部进程、零 Python 依赖。

中文 | [English](README.en.md)
--- ## 快速开始 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @kenz1117/dsh-engram ``` 安装后无需配置即可使用（默认分库与模型缓存在 `~/.dsh/engram`，画像注入开启，自动摄取关闭）。 ## 界面速览 **今日**——记忆宫殿的仪表盘：速览 KPI、半年活动热力、入殿导航、房间目录。

**满宽翻新清单**——每条建议完整展示决策理由与记忆原文，就地阅读、就地执行（降级 / 蒸馏合并），不再挤在小卡里靠弹窗补全。

**陈展**——全量记忆库：房间 / 状态 / 内容过滤，行内铭牌展开与取代链编辑。

## 宫殿结构：目录即房间，路径即路线 记忆宫殿真正管用的是它的**信息架构**，不是那套生物学机制——前者机器完全能用，后者 AI 既没有也不需要。拆开看只有四件事： ``` 主厅 · 常驻核心记忆 少而稳，每次都在场 每轮注入的画像（条数 + token 预算双限） │ 走廊 · 路由索引 先决定进哪个房间，别一上来全库检索 房间目录 + engram_search room= │ ├─ 事实厅 fact 用户说过的事实 ├─ 偏好阁 preference 偏好与口味 ├─ 决策堂 decision 决策与约定 ├─ 往事廊 episode 经历与时间线 └─ 技法坊 skill 方法与技法 每房容量 9，满员开「房名-2」 │ 门牌 · 铭牌纪律 唯一 · 差异化 · 带日期 写入即评分，低分进翻新清单 ``` | 宫殿原则 | 在插件里是什么 | 代码 | |---|---|---| | 位置当索引 | 写入即排桩 `房间#桩位`；房间容量 9（7±2），满员开新房，桩位只增不回收 | [src/palace/slots.ts](src/palace/slots.ts) | | 固定路线定顺序 | `tour_routes` 只增不改；`engram_tour mode=fixed` 按桩位顺序走全宫 | ◀─────────────────────────── ├─ 用户画像快照注入（plugin 来源 user 快照） ├─ engram_save / search / review … ──────▶ ├─ SQLite 双库（user.db / project-.db） │ ├─ FTS5 关键词道 + 本地向量道 RRF 融合 + 排序 boost ├─ engram_distill ───────────────────────▶ ├─ 辅助 LLM 蒸馏（簇合并 → supersedes 链） ├─ 会话结束（reflect 开启）──────────────▶ ├─ 信念巩固（未巩固证据 → observations：近邻归并 / stale 复核） │ └─ 自动摄取：会话日志 → 候选事实（含会话结束的末轮，ingest 开启时） └─ 设置页「记忆库」tab ◀────────────────── ─── 回环 API /api/engram/*（写操作校验回环 Origin） ``` - **双层分库**：`user.db` 全局共享；`project-.db` 按 git origin URL 归一化哈希命名（`git@github.com:a/b.git` 与 `https://github.com/a/b` 同库；worktree 沿指针解析到主仓库 origin）；无 git 或无 origin 时按 **cwd 全量 sha256** 命名（v0.7.6 起；旧的「cwd 前 12 字符」截断命名会同前缀撞库，启动时自动 rename 迁移，新旧并存则不动并告警）。 - **项目宫殿路由**：`GET /api/engram/workspaces` 给出可选项目宫殿清单（来源 = 宿主 `workspaceRegistry` 工作区 → 会话 header 里出现过的 cwd → 插件进程目录兜底，按分库名去重；同仓库的多个 worktree 共用一个宫殿）；所有项目 scope 的接口与工具读写接受选择器（HTTP `?project=` / POST body `project`，工具用当前会话 `session.header.cwd`），未知选择器 HTTP 回 404、工具回退进程目录。面板「项目」scope 默认跟随 GUI 当前工作区并可固定到某个工作区。 - **宫殿结构（目录即房间，路径即路线）**：**主厅** = 每轮注入的常驻核心画像（少而稳，每次都在场）；**走廊** = 画像里附的房间目录 + `engram_search room` 参数（先定房间，再检索）；**房间** = 按 kind 分房（事实厅 / 偏好阁 / 决策堂 / 往事廊 / 技法坊），容量 9，满员开「房名-2」；**门牌** = 每条记忆的 `placard` 铭牌，受唯一·差异化·带日期纪律评分。存量库首次打开时自动补排桩（幂等，开新房会告警提醒人工命名）。 - **自动摄取**（`ingest` 开启时）：新一轮第一步从会话日志提取上一轮的候选事实；会话结束（session/disposed）补摄取最后一轮，5 秒超时，失败/超时把 pending 键写入操作日志，下次会话首步自动重放补做；已摄取的 (会话, 轮次) 幂等去重（键固定在私人库，实时与历史回填共用一份，跨路径不重复）。读取源是会话日志；辅助调用的请求审计走插件自身操作日志，不向会话日志 append 未知事件。候选以低 confidence 写入并按**目标分库内**的嵌入近邻去重。**作用域逐条判**：提炼输出带 `scope`，`project` 落当前会话 cwd 的项目库、`user` 落私人库；无 cwd 的会话只能进私人库（此类会话不做逐条判定，避免标记与实际分库不符）。历史回填沿用同一判定，默认按各会话自己的 cwd 落项目库。 - **来源链**：每条记忆记录来源会话、轮次与事件 seq，`engram_review` 可完整回查；操作日志表记录全部写入/修改/遗忘/蒸馏/衰减。 - **嵌入离线**：模型首次使用需联网下载（q8 约 50MB，端点可配镜像），此后完全离线；失败时插件照常工作，检索降级纯关键词并显式标记。 - **界面本地化**：client 半经宿主 locale 服务注册 zh/en 词典，跟随宿主语言设置实时切换；状态/种类等数据枚举仅在显示层映射，存储值保持英文。 ## Web 管理面板 安装后在宿主**侧栏**出现「记忆宫殿」入口（v0.8 起为独立面板应用，不再寄居设置页），9 缺失时自动执行 pnpm bundle pnpm test # 单测 + 组合测试；真实嵌入 e2e：ENGRAM_E2E=1（可配 HF_ENDPOINT）且网络可达时执行 pnpm typecheck pnpm bundle ``` ### 提 PR 前自检 ```sh node scripts/check-messages.mjs # 代码请求的键都已声明、无孤立键、zh/en/ru 三语配平 node scripts/check-patterns.mjs # 密钥清洗与闲聊拒收在所有已声明语言下的行为 pnpm typecheck pnpm test ``` 前两项在干净的检出上即可运行，CI（`.github/workflows/checks.yml`）跑的正是这两项，另加 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`。后三项不行：`@deepseek-ai/*` peer 不在 npm 上（见 `.npmrc`），只在 `deepseek-harness` 工作区内才能解析。提 PR 前请在本地把四项都跑一遍——字典漏配会在本机大声报错，而依赖语言环境的断言（断言中文文本，而 `language: 'auto'` 落到开发者自己的语言环境）只在别人的机器上变红。 安装与构建脚本的两点说明： - **GitHub 源码快捷安装**（`dsh plugin add github:kenz1117/dsh-engram`）拿的是源码，`prepare` 会在 `lib/` 缺失时自动执行 `pnpm bundle` 现场构建——失败时看 prepare 日志的 bundle 段，而不是宿主报的 "no entry point"。 - **原生依赖构建许可**：`@huggingface/transformers` 传递的原生包（`onnxruntime-node`、`sharp`、`protobufjs`）需要 pnpm 允许运行构建脚本。pnpm 11 已忽略包内 `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` 声明，许可必须写在**使用方**（profile / workspace）侧——pnpm 11 用 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds`，pnpm 10 用同文件的 `onlyBuiltDependencies`。未许可时 pnpm 会跳过这些构建并把跳过列为错误，嵌入功能不可用；许可后重装即可。 ## Model Experience ### Request context and condition #### What the model sees 会话每轮第一步追加一条 plugin 来源的 user 快照：`User memory profile (dsh-engram, cross-session) — Grand Hall (always present):` 加用户级记忆列表（默认至多 8 条且整段不超过 1024 token 预算，超预算条目降级为 `#id` 索引行，`injectProfile: false` 关闭），行内带宫殿坐标（`房间#桩位`）；有到期复习条目时末尾追加一行提示今日待回忆条数。工具调用结果为纯文本行列表（含 `id=`、scope/kind 标注、桩位坐标、矛盾候选提示与降级说明）。自动摄取与蒸馏各产生一次辅助 LLM 调用（独立于主对话计费路径，带 purpose 归因）。 #### Token effect 画像注入为条件性固定成本（受条数上限与 token 预算双重约束）；工具 schema 为常驻成本（20 个窄参数工具）。 #### KV Cache effect 画像文本随记忆库内容变化——变化只体现在新会话或记忆更新后的轮次边界；同一会话内注入内容不变时前缀保持稳定；工具 schema 恒定，不影响前缀。 ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - **矛盾判定默认无 LLM** —— 写入时默认仅按向量相似度（≥0.88）报告候选并建边，语义矛盾的确认留给模型/用户裁决与蒸馏；可配 Jev 裁决（面板「裁决」tab 或 yml `jev`）让模糊带与矛盾边走外部判决，Jev 不可用时回落本默认。 - **嵌入器降级期间的记忆无向量** —— 模型未就绪时写入的记忆不参与语义道；语义上线后跑一次 `pnpm backfill` 补算存量向量（`pnpm build` 的模型缓存就绪后执行，可经 `HF_ENDPOINT` 配镜像）。 ## 路线图 宫殿 IA（位置当索引 / 固定路线 / 检索练习）是索引与审计骨架，按三阶段向 AI 原生的记忆分层与时序事实图谱演进；实际发版按 0.0.1 递增，阶段代号仅为规划标签： - **阶段一 · 飞轮闭环补强**（已完成，v0.7.8）：写入四态回报（ACCEPT 新增 / MERGE 并入强化 / DROP 低熵 / DEFER 矛盾待裁决，`engram_save` 与摄取逐条返回处置）；画像注入改分级递减预算（首条 160 字、逐条 ×0.9、下限 24，可配置）；脱敏扩充中文密码 / 身份证 / 手机号三类；证据门收尾提醒（轮次结束存在未判定 assess 批次时注入提醒）。 - **阶段二 · 记忆分层**：画像可编辑（**已完成，v0.7.9**：`engram_profile_edit` 工具 + 版本链回滚 + 面板 diff 审计，Letta core-memory 路线）；episode 情景记忆独立时间线索引（**已完成，v0.7.9**：`engram_episode_timeline` 工具，日期范围、按会话分组、时间邻近扩展，episode 专用索引；面板「往事」视图 + 摄取期与实时会话摘要组头同批完成）；信念自动巩固（**已完成，v0.7.14**：observations 表（schema v12）带证据链与证据数，会话结束按 `reflect: suggest|auto` 触发，近邻归并持续细化、stale 新鲜度复核四动作 form/refine/still/refute，active 信念随画像注入；手动 `engram_distill` 蒸馏保留）；房间容量与门牌评分可配置化（默认与现状一致）。 - **阶段三 · 时序事实图谱**：实体表与写入期实体抽取消歧（**已完成，v0.7.10**：entities + node_entities 两表，摄取/保存的辅助 LLM 输出带 entities 提及并消解落库，`engram_search` 命中附实体标签，面板「实体」视图 + 实体回环路由）；事实级三元组携带 `valid_at` / `invalid_at` 时间窗，冲突事实软失效不删除（**已完成，v0.7.11**：facts 表（实体 + 时间窗 + `replaced_by` + 来源记忆），摄取辅助 LLM 输出带 facts 并按实体归一化匹配落表，`replaces` 声明软失效链，`engram_search` 加 `asOf` 时点回看，`engram_facts` evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-bili-live · 直播助手（DD版）

**挂在你自己的 B站 账号上，安静地看直播，离场时留一张笔记，顺手给主播打个分。**

守几个主播，或者按喜好关键词自己巡场。进房后三路一起采：弹幕长连接、音频切片转写、定时抽帧看画面；看满设定的时长就走，走之前算一次分、写一张笔记，分数够好的推给你另一个账号。
平时一句话不说，只有被叫到、或者听到你设的关键词才接一句。

> 适用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）桌面版 / Web 版。

---

## 它能做什么

| | 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 👀 | **看弹幕** | 长连接接收弹幕，只读不发。守指定主播（行序即优先级），或按喜好关键词自动巡场。 |
| 👂 | **听声音** | 拉直播音频流切片，本机 faster-whisper 转写。**不花 token、不联网**。听到关键词会接话，也会写进笔记。 |
| 🖼 | **看画面** | 定时从视频流里抽一帧（PyAV 解码，不落临时视频），总结时把画面一起交给模型。 |
| ⭐ | **给主播打分** | 十维评分（另有一项恶意的隐藏扣分），权重自己调。守的主播和巡场遇到的都会打；看不满 60 秒不打分。 |
| 📝 | **写笔记** | 一场直播一张 txt：评分明细、发生了什么、大肥鱼的评价、最热闹的一分钟、弹幕摘录、主播原话。 |
| 🎛 | **手动切台** | 设置页顶上：「换个随机直播间」立刻换一个（不用等看满时长）；也可以填房间号或主播 UID 直接进指定直播间。手动切进去的算随机巡场——照样打分，看满设定时长照样换台。 |
| 📬 | **高分推送** | 分数过线时把这场推给指定的 B站 账号（B站 不允许发给自己，要填另一个 UID）。只推随机巡场遇到的，守的主播分数只留在笔记里。 |

## 一场直播的流程

```
进房（守名单或随机巡场）
   ↓
三路同时采：弹幕长连接 / 15 秒音频切片 / 每 2 分钟一张画面
   ↓
离场（主播下播、被更高优先级顶掉、看满巡场时长、你点了停止）
   ↓
算分 → 模型写笔记 → 过线推送 → 删掉这一场的切片与截图
```

## 随机巡场

关注名单留空（或关掉「启用关注名单」）时，插件自己挑台：

1. 没看过的、命中**喜好关键词**的房间优先
2. 没命中但也没看过的
3. 实在没得挑才回到最近看过的（记最近 12 间）

还有一种情况也会随机逛：**开着关注名单、但名单上的主播一个都没在播**。默认就会按上面的顺序随机进一个直播间（设置页「名单里全都没在播时，也去随机逛」可关掉；关掉就只在名单里干等，绝不进别人的直播间）。他们一开播，下一轮检查就会切回优先级更高的那位。

默认每间看 30 分钟就换；看不满 60 秒被切走的那一场不打分、不推送。

## 评分怎么算

十个维度，评的是**这个主播的水平**，不是「这场热不热闹」。每项先按各自满分线归一（跨数量级的走对数，比率走线性），再按权重加权，满分 10 分：

| 维度 | 默认权重 | 满分线 | 归一 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 粉丝付费率（挂牌付费者 ÷ 本场出场人数） | 19% | 10% | 线性 |
| 直播互动（每百人每分钟弹幕） | 16% | 12 条 | 对数 |
| 观众参与（发言人数 ÷ 本场出场人数） | 12% | 25% | 线性 |
| 粉丝浓度（挂牌人数 ÷ 本场出场人数） | 12% | 15% | 线性 |
| 作品获赞（每稿获赞） | 10% | 随粉丝数浮动，见下表 | 对数 |
| 更新频率（月投稿） | 8% | 5 稿/月 | 线性 |
| 路人付费率（未挂牌付费者 ÷ 本场出场人数） | 8% | 25% | 线性 |
| 弹幕热度（条/分） | 7% | 6 | 对数 |
| 人气规模（同接） | 5% | 30 人 | 对数 |
| 路人转化率（新增粉丝团 ÷ 本场出场人数） | 3% | 10% | 线性 |

作品获赞的满分线按**粉丝数**浮动（获赞是作品数据，跟今晚来了多少人没关系：237 人房的果宝 33882 赞/稿，10097 人房的大东彦只有 5279）：

| 粉丝数 | 1万 | 5万 | 20万 | 50万 | 100万 | 200万 | 500万 | 1000万+ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 满分线 | 300/稿 | 600 | 1500 | 3000 | 6000 | 12000 | 30000 | 60000 |

锚点之间线性插值；粉丝数拿不到时退回 600，不连累主播。

权重在设置页自己填百分数，**不用凑满 100**（算分时按合计归一），填 0 就是完全不看那一项。

分母分两套：`crowd = max(同接, 30)` 只给「每百人弹幕」用，防止个位数房间算出「每百人 125 条」这种鬼数字；`heads = max(同接, 5)` 给其余所有「人数 ÷ 同接」的指标（参与、浓度、两个付费率、转化），只防 1~4 人的极端比例。付费率以前误用了 30 人兜底，30 人以下的小房间会被整体腰斩（15 人的房 3 个路人付费本来是 20%，除以 30 只剩 10%）。

### 档位

| 分数 | 档位 |
| --- | --- |
| ≥ 9 | S · 顶尖 |
| ≥ 8 | A · 很强 |
| ≥ 6 | B · 中上 |
| ≥ 4 | C · 一般 |
| ≥ 2 | D · 偏弱 |
| < 2 | E · 很弱 |

### 恶意内容扣分（隐藏项）

弹幕里出现带节奏、网络暴力、粗鄙语言时，结算会额外问一次模型：恶意弹幕条数超过阈值（默认 10 条）才扣分，**最多扣 5 分，扣到 0 为止**。**本场只要有封禁**（房管或主播封过人，系统自动封也算），就一律不扣分——现场已经制止过了。判定前会先分清是开玩笑（熟人互损、玩梗、跟风复读）还是真恶意，拿不准的一律不算。

接口只告诉你「谁被封了」，不告诉你为什么封，所以没法区分「封恶意弹幕」和「封广告刷屏」——一律按免责处理，宁可少扣，不冤枉已经管过场的主播。碰到「弹幕确实脏、但有人封过」这种分不清的情况，大肥鱼会在评价里如实交代一句：看到了一些不干净的弹幕，但现场已经封禁处理，分不清封的是不是这些，这次先不扣分。

只审弹幕，不审语音——转写有错字、分不清主播和连麦者，拿它扣分容易冤。

这一项**不出现在直播助手正文里**，只在评分日志和笔记的评分行后面挂一段算式：

```
评分：6.5/10（B 档 · 中上）｜8.5 − 2 = 6.5
```

同接取的是 `getOnlineGoldRank` 返回的真实在线人数，不是页面上那个虚高几百倍的「人气值」。

## 直播笔记长什么样

```
2026-10-17 · 某主播 的直播
==============================================
直播间：https://live.bilibili.com/00000
开播标题：今天随便聊聊
观看时段：20:01 ~ 21:20（1 小时 19 分）
弹幕：共 1234 条，89 人发言
语音：转写出 210 段主播说的话
同接峰值：76 人在看
评分：7.6/10（B 档 · 还行）
　同接 76（13.2 分） · 发言人数 30（14.8 分） · 弹幕 10（13.7 分） · 月投稿 50（20 分）
　付费 10（10 分） · 大航海 0（0 分） · 获赞率 507（5 分） · 互动率 13（2.4 分）
==============================================

【这场直播大概发生了什么】
（模型写的 100~180 字现场笔记）

【大肥鱼的评价】
（模型写的 60~120 字主观看法：值不值得看、什么路数）

【最热闹的一分钟】
21:03 前后（12 条）

【弹幕摘录】
21:03 观众A：……
```

模型不可用时不会整张空白，会退化成「本地统计版」（时长、条数、最热闹的一分钟、高频词）。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:你的用户名/dsh-bili-live

# 或从本地目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/bili-live
```

装完**重启 DSH**，侧边栏「设置 → 直播助手（DD版）」就是它的设置页。

### 听声音需要本机 ASR 环境（可选）

语音转写用本机 Python + faster-whisper，两部分都要有：

```bash
# 1. 建 venv 并装依赖
python -m venv ~/.dsh/bili-live/.venv-asr
~/.dsh/bili-live/.venv-asr/Scripts/pip install faster-whisper

# 2. 下载模型（首次转写会自动下，也可手动预热）
#    默认 medium，约 1.5 GB；机器吃力可在设置页切 small
```

找不到 Python 时插件只是「听不到声音」，弹幕、画面、评分、笔记照常工作。
抽帧只需要 `av`（PyAV）与 `Pillow`：

```bash
~/.dsh/bili-live/.venv-asr/Scripts/pip install av Pillow
```

## 隐私

- **凭证只认自己扫的**：插件自带扫码登录，不借用其它插件的登录态；没扫码就显示「还没有登录」。凭证存在插件家目录 `~/.dsh/bili-live/credential.json`，每 10 分钟校验一次，过期自动掉线。
- **语音转写在本机跑**：音频不出本机，不花 token。只有「接一句话」和「写一张笔记」会调用模型。
- **不采集你的账号信息**：插件只读直播间的公开数据（房间信息、弹幕、音频流）。

## 成本

| 动作 | token |
| --- | --- |
| 听声音、抽画面 | **0**（本机计算） |
| 接一句话 | 约 800 |
| 写一张笔记 | 约 8k ~ 9.5k（含 3 张画面） |

一场 3 分钟的小直播约 9k token；长时间挂机时，也可以把「总结参考画面」关掉来省。

## 边界与注意事项

- **弹幕发送受 B站 风控约束**：需要登录 cookie 与 `buvid3`；冷却与每日上限是为了不刷屏被封，别调得太激进。
- **@ 识别是文本层面**：B站 弹幕里的 @ 不一定带结构化字段，按「文本里出现名字/别名」判断，可能偶尔误判。
- **部分直播间有发言等级限制**：发不出去时日志里有报错，插件照常观看，只是说不了话。
- **弹幕与语音记录只在内存里**：进程中途退出，这一场就没了（只在正常离场时落盘）。
- **跟随 DSH 进程**：关掉 DSH 就停止守候，插件不常驻后台。
- **B站 不允许给自己发私信**：高分推送要填另一个账号的 UID，留空则分数只写进笔记。

## 目录结构

```
index.js            宿主端：轮询开播、进退房间、读弹幕、触发回复、算分、写笔记（含 /api/bili-live/* 路由）
client.js           浏览器端：设置页那一页（自注册模块）
lib/live.mjs        与 B站 直播接口打交道（房间信息 / 弹幕长连接 / 发弹幕 / 拉流地址 / 随机房间）
lib/audio.mjs       音频拉流与切片（FLV 增量解析，只留音频 tag）
lib/asr.mjs         常驻转写进程的宿主侧封装（faster-whisper）
lib/vision.mjs      画面抽样（FLV 切片 → 抽帧）
lib/rating.mjs      十维评分：采集、归一、加权
lib/moderation.mjs  恶意内容审核（隐藏扣分，只审弹幕）
lib/recap.mjs       直播记录器 + txt 笔记落盘
lib/auth.mjs        扫码登录
lib/llm.mjs         借宿主 llm 服务生成回复与总结（失败静默降级）
lib/config.mjs      配置默认值与归一化
lib/cleanup.mjs     离场清理（切片、截图）
tools/asr_worker.py 转写工作进程（stdin/stdout 一行一条 JSON）
tools/grab_frame.py 抽帧进程（stdin 送 FLV，stdout 回 JPEG）
vendor/qrcode.js    二维码生成（MIT，qrcode-generator 1.4.4）
cordis.patch.yml    告诉 DSH：这个插件要跑起来
```

# dsh-reverie

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Reverie is an **isolated, read-only, open-ended association experiment** for DeepSeek Harness. It treats your own persisted session history as its corpus, lets a model pick its own topic, search, expand originals and follow an association as far as it wants, and leaves exactly two things behind: a report and a bounded private note.

It is not a task system and not a profile generator. Wandering, dead ends and "this trip produced nothing" are all valid outcomes.

```text
reverie_status    config, corpus and model route at a glance
reverie_sessions  which sessions this run would read
reverie_search    lexical search, returning <sessionId>#<seq> evidence locators
reverie_read      expand one locator into the original window
reverie_run       run one trip (mock by default, no model call)
reverie_report    read back a report / note / trail
reverie_config    inspect or change runtime settings
```

## Why a plugin

The original Reverie lived inside a private companion system, where its corpus was that system's memory layers and its only user was one person. As a DSH plugin:

- the corpus becomes **any DSH user's own session history**, so it works the moment it is installed;
- each trip still owns its messages, reads the corpus read-only, and writes nothing back to memory — artifacts go under `~/.dsh/reverie/runs/`;
- `mock` mode needs no API key at all: install it, inspect a real artifact, then decide whether to spend tokens.

## Install

DSH Desktop: install `@kleinkross/dsh-reverie` from **Settings → Plugins**.

CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kleinkross/dsh-reverie
```

Local development (works before publishing):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-reverie
```

The installer adds the package to your profile's bundle list; restart `dsh web` (or let HMR pick it up) and the tools appear.

## Quick start

1. `reverie_status` — confirm the corpus is non-empty, a model route is available, and the mode is `mock`.
2. `reverie_run` — run one mock trip. No model is called; this exercises the corpus, the ranking, the artifact writer and the report shape.
3. `reverie_report` — read the generated report and `handoff.md`.
4. To do it for real, set `mode: "live"` with `reverie_config` (or pass `live: true` to one call) and run again. That spends API budget.

Check `reverie_sessions` before the first real run: it shows exactly which sessions the current `scope` would read.

## Data and privacy

- **Read-only**: nothing is appended to, rewritten in, or deleted from any session, memory store or corpus file.
- **Only what people said**: user messages injected by the harness (workspace instructions, runtime snapshots, the skill catalog) are excluded by `source.kind`; reasoning and tool traffic never become corpus text.
- **Closed sessions only**: the live conversation you are in is excluded; it can never become its own experiment material.
- **Current workspace by default**: `scope: "workspace"`; set `"all"` to read every local workspace.
- **No network beyond the model call**: no telemetry, no uploads, no third-party requests; `mock` is fully offline.
- **Artifacts**: `$DSH_HOME/reverie/runs/<date>/<run-id>/{run.json,report.md,handoff.md,events.jsonl,usage.json}` plus `latest.json`. Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/reverie/config.json`.
- **Reports and notes are model-generated** (live runs), not authoritative memory. Expand the `<sessionId>#<seq>` locator before believing a claim.

## Settings

```jsonc
{
  "scope": "workspace",     // workspace | all
  "includeSubagents": false,// subagent sessions stay out of the corpus by default
  "maxSessions": 24,        // persisted sessions read per trip
  "lookbackDays": 0,        // 0 = no time limit
  "maxDocuments": 4000,     // message ceiling
  "minDocumentChars": 24,   // shorter messages never enter the corpus
  "cacheTtlMs": 600000,     // corpus cache lifetime
  "provider": "",           // empty = first registered provider
  "model": "",              // empty = that provider's first advertised model
  "reasoningEffort": "",
  "mode": "mock",           // mock costs nothing; live spends API budget
  "maxSteps": 8,
  "maxInputTokens": 60000,  // cumulative input ceiling (provider usage when reported)
  "maxOutputTokens": 2048,
  "timeoutMs": 600000,
  "maxNoteChars": 2000,
  "persona": "",            // optional persona/voice file path
  "language": "zh"          // report and prompt language: zh | en
}
```

Change it through `reverie_config` or by editing the JSON file; every call re-reads it, and invalid fields are rejected and reported instead of being silently ignored.

## Compatibility

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`; developed and tested on the 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop build |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Host services | `tools` and `systemPrompt` are required; when `sessionQuery` (corpus) or `llm` (live runs) are missing the plugin still mounts and the tools say what is absent |
| Peers | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` |

## Architecture

```text
ctx.sessionQuery ──► corpus.js ──► search.js ──► loop.js ──► artifacts.js
 (read-only corpus)  (normalized)   (BM25 + CJK)  (tool loop)   (runs/ output)
                                        │
                                  mock.js (deterministic, no model call)
```

- `lib/index.js` only assembles: register the tools and the system-prompt announcement.
- `lib/corpus.js` reads through `ctx.sessionQuery`, keeping persisted non-live sessions only; inside a session it keeps the current surface and only what a person or the model actually said — harness injections (`agent-instructions`, `runtime-context`, the skill catalog) share the user role but carry a different `source.kind`, and reasoning/tool traffic is filtered out. One unreadable session is reported as a problem instead of erasing the corpus.
- `lib/search.js` is host-free: latin words plus CJK characters and bi-grams, BM25, literal-phrase bonus. The same corpus and query always rank the same way.
- `lib/loop.js` is Reverie's own model loop: one streamed step at a time, block assembly, inner tool dispatch (`reverie_search` / `reverie_read` / `reverie_note`). Budget exhaustion is reported as `budget` / `max-steps`, never dressed up as the model deciding to finish.
- `lib/artifacts.js` writes runs; `lib/runs.js` reads them only through a validated run id and a fixed file allowlist.
- `lib/tools.js` is the model-facing surface.

Design choices:

- **`ctx.sessionQuery`, not hand-parsed `.jsonl.zstd`**: the corpus must be the model-visible history itself, and the plugin should not carry storage-format knowledge.
- **No reuse of the host agent loop**: Reverie's experiment identity requires owning its messages and budget without occupying the daily conversation.
- **`mock` is a first-class mode**: anyone can verify the whole pipeline without an API key, and the regression suite costs nothing.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test              # in-process runner (works in restricted sandboxes)
npm run test:isolated # one child process per file (requires spawning)
```

The suite covers config validation, corpus filtering and caching, BM25 ranking and phrase bonus, loop tool dispatch / budgets / errors, mock determinism, and every tool end-to-end including one live run against a fake model route.

## Scope and limits

- The corpus is read-only; the plugin never writes back to memory, session logs or compaction state.
- Tools live in the agent's tool table only. There is no background scheduler: when a trip happens is up to the human and the model.
- Live cost is determined by the host's provider. Budgets here are pre-checks (steps and token ceilings), not a hard billing limit.
- A report or note may be quoted by later conversation or a subagent, but it is not evidence. Evidence is always the original text behind a locator.

MIT License.

# dsh-moe-clean · 鲸鱼娘轻量皮肤

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.6.3-2f6bf0?style=flat-square)
![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-1f2a3a?style=flat-square)
![code](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-2f6bf0?style=flat-square)
![artwork](https://img.shields.io/badge/artwork-CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-c5a468?style=flat-square)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的一套安静、轻量的白蓝皮肤：白色为主、DeepSeek 蓝做点缀，侧栏和输入框是毛玻璃，右侧一张做了渐隐的鲸鱼娘女仆立绘。

| 亮色 | 暗色 |
| --- | --- |
| ![亮色](docs/preview-light.png) | ![暗色](docs/preview-dark.png) |

## 为什么是轻量

- **无构建、无运行时依赖**：装完即用，不需要 node_modules 里的第三方库；
- **只有 8 个静态资源**：左右两张立绘、两张 Q 版女仆（弹窗底纹 / 完全权限警告）、鲸鱼水印、hover 动图及其首帧、HARNESS 缎带；
- **纯外观**：CSS 设计令牌 + 少量 DOM 装饰，宿主侧只注册一个只读资源路由；
- **可完整还原**：卸载插件后原生图标、背景和尺寸都会回到原样。

## 特性

- **白 + 蓝**：白色表面、冷蓝灰中性色，全界面只有 DeepSeek 蓝 `#2f6bf0` 一个强调色；
- **毛玻璃**：只用在侧栏和输入框（`backdrop-filter`），正文区保持通透；设置等弹窗是 55% 白 + `blur(44px)` 的磨砂面，不再透出背后的正文；
- **右侧鲸鱼娘**：默认 60%、暗色 72% 不透明度，左侧与底部用渐变蒙版淡出，右侧再加一层冷色雾化，压字不挡字；
- **左侧栏底纹**：另一张女仆立绘铺在侧栏底部，收起成图标栏时自动隐藏；
- **鲸鱼水印**：左下角一枚 20% 不透明的 DeepSeek 鲸鱼，窄窗口自动隐藏；
- **蓝色字标**：顶栏的 deepseek 鲸鱼与 HARNESS 徽章统一成 DeepSeek 蓝，暗色自动切更亮的浅蓝 `#9cc2ff`；
- **HARNESS 缎带**：顶栏的 HARNESS 徽章替换成手绘风蕾丝缎带 + 蓝蝴蝶结，文字仍可读；
- **插件图标 hover 动效**：平时显示 GIF 的第一帧（22px 静态图），鼠标移上去才播放摇摆动画，移开回到第一帧；暗色自动反相；
- **弹窗女仆**：设置/登录等弹窗右下角一枚 17% 透明的 Q 版女仆，58% 宽，贴着圆角往外压一点、被裁掉少许；蒙版沿左上→右下方向 135° 淡出，不留方形边缘；
- **完全权限警告**：只有「确认启用完全权限」这个风险弹窗换成另一张会指人的 Q 版女仆——40% 透明、42% 宽，往右下角压得更深（尾巴和鞋被弹窗边缘裁掉），伸出的食指正好落在按钮上方；
- **弹层不透明度下限**：命令面板、下拉菜单等 popover 统一提到 80% 以上，避免背后的正文透出来；
- **自定义图标**：「新会话」换成鲸鱼气泡加号，「插件」换成鲸尾，导航尺寸统一；
- **亮暗跟随**：不需要手动切换，沿用 DSH 的 `data-ds-dark-theme`。

图标效果：

![侧栏图标](docs/icons.png)

## 安装

### 桌面版

侧栏「插件」→「添加插件」，填入：

```text
github:KurosawaGeeker/dsh-moe-clean
```

安装后**重启一次 DSH**。

### CLI（web profile）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:KurosawaGeeker/dsh-moe-clean'
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，刷新页面。

### 本地目录 / tarball

```sh
git clone https://github.com/KurosawaGeeker/dsh-moe-clean
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-moe-clean
# 或
npm pack && dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-moe-clean-0.6.3.tgz
```

> 桌面版由应用管理自己的 `desktop` profile，用 `web` profile 的命令不会装到桌面版里。

## 兼容性

| DSH | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | 实测（桌面版 / web） |
| 其它 `0.2.x` | 未实测，图标选择器依赖 aria-label |

只用到了 CSS 变量、`data-*` 属性和按钮的 `aria-label`，不触碰内部类名哈希。DSH 改版后如果图标没被替换，通常是 aria 文案变了，改一下 `lib/client.js` 里的正则即可。

## 自定义

立绘浓度、玻璃强度、图标大小都是普通 CSS，可以在自己的补丁层里覆盖：

```css
/* 右侧立绘更淡 */
.dsh-moe-maid { opacity: 0.42; }

/* 侧栏底纹小一点 */
[class*="sidebarCol"] { background-size: 92% auto !important; }

/* 新会话图标再大一点 */
svg[data-moe-chat-icon] { width: 26px !important; height: 26px !important; }
```

## 卸载

插件页卸载，或：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-moe-clean
```

立绘、水印、图标和毛玻璃会一并移除，原生界面恢复。

## 目录结构

```text
dsh-moe-clean/
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # 单个 entry：ui-moe-clean
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js           # 宿主：只读资源路由 /api/dsh-moe-clean/assets
│  └─ client.js          # 浏览器：主题 CSS + 立绘 + 图标替换
├─ assets/
│  ├─ maid-left.webp     # 侧栏底纹
│  ├─ maid-right.webp    # 右侧立绘
│  └─ whale.svg          # 左下角鲸鱼水印
├─ docs/                 # README 截图
├─ LICENSE               # MIT（代码）
├─ LICENSE-ARTWORK       # CC BY-NC-SA 4.0（美术）
└─ NOTICE                # 署名链
```

## 从 0.1 到 0.8

- **0.1**：暖米色极简主题，去掉原版皮肤的巴洛克装饰；
- **0.2**：加入毛玻璃和右侧立绘，立绘 60% 渐隐；
- **0.3**：整体改成白 + 蓝，侧栏铺女仆底纹，加入鲸鱼水印；
- **0.4**：按实际截图修布局——侧栏底纹按宽度缩放、整身可见、收起时隐藏；窄屏和暗色单独验证；加号居中到身体重心；
- **0.5**：接入「新会话」鲸鱼气泡图标（替换原生 16×16 图标，Observer 防回退）；
- **0.6**：接入「插件」鲸尾图标，导航图标统一到 20px，「新会话」24px；
- **0.7**：弹窗（设置、登录等）从半透明改成磨砂玻璃，`blur(44px)` + 55% 底色，不再透出页面正文；
- **0.8**：弹窗右下角加入 Q 版女仆水印（17% 透明、渐变淡出）；
- **0.9**：「插件」图标 hover 时播放摇摆 GIF；
- **0.11**：静止态改为 GIF 的首帧，不再用线框 SVG；
- **0.11.3**：弹窗女仆贴到右下角、允许被圆角裁掉少许，渐隐改成一条 135° 对角蒙版。

## 许可与署名

- **代码**：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；
- **美术资源**：CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，**禁止商业使用**，署名链见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)：
  1. **一创 上善** —— 鲸鱼娘角色形象原作（[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/62155430)）；
  2. **二创 ZipZipPipe** —— 加入 DeepSeek 元素的女仆鲸鱼娘（[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/18604994)）；
  3. **三创 Small-tailqwq** —— [dsh-deep-whale](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale) 皮肤中的立绘整理；
- **图标**：鲸鱼气泡与鲸尾图标由仓库作者基于 DeepSeek 元素改造；左下角水印使用 DeepSeek 鲸鱼标识。

本项目与 DeepSeek 官方无关。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Single-kernel architecture | **occt.ts as the primary modeling kernel** (true B-splines, native shell/draft, centroid); opencascade.js stays only as the fallback backend; the old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane); sections may differ in shape and point count; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling primarily runs on the **occt.ts kernel** (opencascade.js as the fallback backend) (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (opencascade.js WASM)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (opencascade.js, full OCCT) are separate, both lazily started; the `_N`
  suffix convention of embind overloaded constructors is wrapped in
  `src/modeling/occt-adapter.cjs` (all verified at runtime)
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. New APIs over opencascade.js: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Single-kernel architecture**: the primary modeling kernel is
  **occt.ts** — primitives, curve-segment profiles (TRUE B-spline
  interpolation), loft/sweep/revolve, booleans, fillet/chamfer, shell/draft,
  mirror (composed as scale(-1) + a π rotation) and centroid all live in one
  session; engineering-drawing HLR takes the shape directly (zero STEP hops);
  editing after shelling is seamless (the old hosted-body seam is deleted).
  opencascade.js remains as the FALLBACK backend (auto-selected when occt.ts
  cannot load). Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document** (occt.ts
  `writeStepDocument`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh; the fallback backend also fuses). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/m0-kernel-check.cjs        # OCCT kernel API smoke test
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

dsh-workspace-prompt

给每个工作区一段专属提示词。
写一次、打开开关，这个工作区的每个新会话都会带上它；每个会话第一次带上之前，只问你一次。

> 纯第三方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，不改 Harness 源码；界面只在 Web Client 提供。 ## 它解决什么问题 同一个 Harness 里常常并排开着好几个仓库：前端要 pnpm 和中文提交信息，后端要 Gradle，文档库只想要简洁回答。把这些规则塞进每次对话既啰嗦又容易漏；写进全局提示词，又会串到别的项目里。 `dsh-workspace-prompt` 把提示词挂到**工作区**上： - **按工作区隔离** —— 以会话的绝对工作目录（`cwd`）为 key，不同工作区互不影响。 - **默认不注入** —— 保存只是存下来；打开输入框工具行的开关，才真正进入模型上下文。 - **每个会话只问一次** —— 第一次真正要注入时弹一张确认卡；选「不带」的会话不再询问、也不再注入，开关状态不变。 - **重启不丢** —— 提示词与开关保存在插件 `Config` 里，由 Harness 的 user-settings provider 写入 profile 用户层。 - **与 `AGENTS.md` 共存** —— 复用官方 `agent-instructions` 的注入形态，transcript 里显示为折叠的「上下文注入」行，而不是用户气泡。 ## 界面一览 ### ① 用斜杠命令配置 在任意会话里输入 `/workspace-prompt`，选择 **配置工作区提示词**。命令只在当前会话绑定了 `cwd` 时出现。 弹窗会回显已存的值；**保存** 写入该工作区，**清除** 连同开关状态一起删除。 ### ② 打开输入框工具行的开关 保存后，输入框工具行出现「**工作区提示词-关**」；点一下变成「**工作区提示词-开**」并带一层浅灰底色（与输入框里 `⊕` 按钮同一个灰）。没有任何提示词的工作区不会出现这个开关。 ### ③ 每个会话首次发送时确认一次 开关打开后，某个会话第一次真正需要注入时会出现这张卡： - **带上** —— 选项后面直接列出该工作区配置的提示词，选了就并入本会话的模型上下文； - **不带** —— 本会话不再询问、也不再注入，**开关保持原状**（下个会话会重新问一次）。 卡片文案只显示一种语言，跟随 DSH 的界面语言：设置里选过语言就按它来，没选过则按宿主系统语言（本地 `dsh web` 下与浏览器的默认语言一致）。 确认卡走官方 `ctx.userQuestions` 通道（审批、计划评审用的是同一个通道），所以它会出现在该会话里，并且这一步会等你回答后才继续。 ### ④ 设置页集中管理 **设置 → 工作区提示词** 用一张工作区列表集中管理：已配置的按名称排在前面（提示词预览、开关、展开箭头），中间用「未配置的工作区」分割行隔开，未配置的只读展示；点行就地展开编辑器，保存 / 清除都在编辑器内完成，右上角仍是原来的 **添加工作区** 菜单。 ## 快速开始 ### 安装 把已发布的包安装进自定义 Web profile。产物不含指向 Harness checkout 的路径依赖，`dsh.bundle` patch 会自动加入 Host 和 Client 插件行： ```sh dsh --profile web-prompt --from-default-profile web --dump-config dsh plugin --profile web-prompt add @linbin-mk/dsh-workspace-prompt dsh --profile web-prompt ``` 改为安装本地构建的 tarball： ```sh pnpm install pnpm build # tsc 产出 lib/types/*.d.ts；tsdown 产出 lib/index.js + lib/client.js pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web-prompt add ./linbin-mk-dsh-workspace-prompt-.tgz ``` 包声明了 `dsh.client` 入口，插件进入组合树后 web shell 会自动加载 `lib/client.js`；node 端 `lib/index.js` 负责声明可实时编辑的 `Config` 并在 `agent/pre-step` 注入提示词。 ### 五步用起来 1. 打开要配置的工作区里的任意会话； 2. 输入 `/workspace-prompt`，选择 **配置工作区提示词**，写好内容后点 **保存**； 3. 在输入框工具行点击「工作区提示词」，标签从 `-关` 变为 `-开`； 4. 正常发消息；本会话第一次需要注入时，在确认卡上选 **带上** 或 **不带**； 5. 不再需要时，关掉开关，或在弹窗 / 设置页点 **清除**。 ## 行为细节 | 项目 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | 作用域 | 提示词与开关都以会话的绝对工作目录（`cwd`）为 key；会话的 `cwd` 必须与设置页里的工作区路径完全一致。 | | 默认状态 | 关闭。没有提示词的工作区不显示开关，输入框工具行与原生完全一样。 | | 注入时机 | 开关打开后，在 `agent/pre-step` 钩子里注入；每一步先检查该内容是否已在会话上下文中，避免重复。 | | 会话确认 | 每个会话只在首次真正注入时问一次。选过「带上」的会话，如果提示词文本变了、或上下文被压缩掉，会直接用最新文本重新注入，不再询问。 | | 持久化 | 存在插件 `Config` 的 `prompts` / `enabled` 两个可实时编辑字段里，由 Harness 的 settings provider 落到 profile 用户层。 | | 无提问通道时 | profile 没有 `userQuestions`、headless 运行、子代理或被托管（`DELEGATED_CALLER`）时，退回开关语义直接注入；用户关闭/忽略（`ASK_CANCELLED`）视作本轮「不带」。 | | 生效时机 | 改动从下一步生效：中途打开开关，当前会话的下一次请求就会带上；中途改文本，下一次请求追加新文本，历史里更早的值不变。 | ## 要求 - Node.js `^22.19` 或 `>=24`； - DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 或兼容的 `0.2.1` 预发布版本，以及提供 `ctx.settings` / `ctx.configForms` / `ctx.agent` 的 Web profile；会话首次确认还需要 `ctx.userQuestions`（Web profile 默认含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions`，缺失时退回开关语义）； - 本包只在 Web Client 端提供界面，不提供终端或桌面端入口。 ## 工作原理 ### Host 端（`src/index.ts` + `src/inject.ts`，作为 Cordis 插件加载） - 声明 Cordis `Config`：`prompts: Record` 与 `enabled: Record`，都标记为 `.volatile()`，因此可以在设置表单里实时编辑。loader 行 id `workspace-prompt` 就是它的 settings 命名空间，Host 侧改动由 Harness 的 settings provider 落到 profile 用户层并实时推给插件。插件自带设置页，因此 `apply` 里用 `ctx.settings.configure({ auto: false })` 关掉自动生成的配置页。 - 监听 `agent/pre-step`。每一步读取会话的 `header.cwd`；**只有该工作区的 `enabled` 为 `true`** 时才去取 `prompts`。命中且该内容还没出现在会话上下文里时，先通过 `ctx.get('userQuestions')?.ask(...)` 问一次（每个会话只问一次，答案在整个会话里复用），选「带上」才生成一条包在 `` 里的 `user/message`，在 agent inbox 中维护它，并并入该步的决策，使其进入首个模型请求与持久化日志。提问前按界面语言只生成一种文案，并把提示词原文放在「带上」选项的说明里。 - 纯注入、开关判定与 inbox 对账逻辑在 `src/inject.ts`（`promptFor` / `enabledFor`）；提问载荷与判定在 `src/confirm.ts`（`confirmQuestions` / `readInclude` / `SessionDecisions`）；文案语言的选择在 `src/language.ts`（优先 `locale.preference`，否则宿主系统语言）；`src/index.ts` 负责把它们接到 Cordis 上下文上。 - **问不到人时不阻塞**：没有 `userQuestions` 服务、没人能应答（headless 运行）、当前 agent 是子代理或被托管（`DELEGATED_CALLER`）时，插件退回开关语义直接注入。 ### Client 端（`src/client/index.ts`，作为插件的 `dsh.client` 半加载） - 注册名为 `workspace-prompt` 的 `CommandContribution`；斜杠菜单项仅在当前会话有 `cwd` 时出现。 - 注册一个 `shell.overlay` 模态框（`WorkspacePromptModal`），接到一个小的 `HostObservable` 上。选择该命令时通过共享配置表单（`ctx.configForms.get('workspace-prompt')`，entry id 与 loader 行 id 一致）读取当前值并打开模态框；表单不可写（未就绪或 Host 拒绝写入）时，保存/清除按钮保持禁用。 - **保存 / 清除** 通过同一个共享配置表单回写（`form.mutate`，对 `prompts.` 执行 `set` / `unset` 路径操作；清除会同时 `unset` `enabled.`；Host 拒绝时表单返回 `false`，界面按失败提示），因此回显的值与注入的值共用同一数据源。 - 注册输入框工具行的开关（`conversation.input.left`，`WorkspacePromptToggle`）：用 `useSessions` 取当前会话的 `cwd`，只在状态里存在该工作区的提示词时渲染；点击写 `enabled.`。两态是同一个 chip 的两种底色与两种标签：关闭 = 透明底 + 次要文字色 + `-关`，开启 = `--dsw-specific-selector` 浅灰底 + 主文字色 + `-开`。写失败、配置只读、以及 **Host 半仍是升级前版本** 时，控件用 `aria-disabled` + 变灰而不是真 `disabled`（真 disabled 会吞掉 tooltip），悬停时说明原因。 - 注册 **设置 → 工作区提示词** 总览页（`settings.section`）。页面是一张工作区列表：已配置的按名称排在前面、显示提示词预览与开关，未配置的以只读行排在「未配置的工作区」分割行之后；点行就地展开编辑器，保存 / 清除在编辑器内完成。**添加工作区** 下拉的数据来自 `useWorkspaces` 标准钩子，只列出尚未配置提示词的已注册工作区。页面同样订阅共享配置表单：写入结果与 Host 侧变更都会立即反映到列表，表单未就绪或不可写时所有写入控件禁用。页面样式是 `WorkspacePromptsSection.module.css`，构建时内联进 client bundle 并自动加 `wsp-` 前缀。 ## 为什么入口是斜杠命令，而不是工作区「更多」弹出菜单 `packages/client/ui-workspace` 里的工作区操作菜单（`重命名` / `删除工作区`）在 `Rows.tsx` 中是硬编码的，**没有留给菜单项的 slot 或扩展点**。不改 Harness 源码的插件无法在那两行之间插入自己的项。本插件改用已有的 `commandUi` + `shell.overlay` 扩展点，无需改动 Harness。（如果你确实想让它出现在那个弹出菜单里，需要在 `ui-workspace` 加一行扩展点——属于改 Harness 源码。） ## 说明 / 限制 - 开关与提示词的改动都在下一步生效：中途打开开关，当前会话的下一次请求就会带上提示词；中途改文本，下一次请求追加新文本，历史里更早的值保持不变。 - 模态框入口是斜杠命令，不是工作区「更多」弹出菜单（见上文）。 - 本包要求 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 或兼容的 `0.2.1` 预发布版本（插件配置即 Cordis `Config`，浏览器侧通过 `ctx.configForms` 读写）。它是独立的第三方插件，不受 Harness `packages/*` 的测试/覆盖率门禁约束；集成效果必须在运行中的 Harness 中验证。 - 提示词只在开关打开时占用该工作区的上下文预算；写得越长，留给对话的空间越少。 - 开关按工作区记忆：在一个会话里打开，该工作区的其他会话（含之后新建的）也会带上提示词，直到再次关闭。 - 每个会话只问**首次**：选过「不带」的会话不会再问、也不会再注入（想在会话中途改主意，把开关关掉再打开即可——新会话自然重新问）。选过「带上」的会话若后来改了提示词文本、或上下文被压缩掉，会**直接**用最新文本重新注入，不再询问。 - 确认卡文案跟随 DSH 的界面语言，**只显示中文或英文中的一种**：优先读设置里的 `locale.preference`，没选过时按宿主系统语言判断（问题协议没有本地化通道，宿主只能在提问前二选一）；「带上」选项的说明直接展示该工作区配置的提示词。 ## 故障排查 - **斜杠菜单里没有这一项** —— 只有当前会话有 `cwd` 时才提供该命令；在未绑定工作区的会话里它不会出现。 - **提示词没有注入** —— 先看输入框工具行：开关默认是 `关`；没有这个开关就说明当前工作区还没配置提示词。开关是 `开` 时，再确认提示词保存在**当前会话所属工作区**的 key（绝对路径）下——会话的 `cwd` 与你在设置页看到的工作区路径必须完全一致。 - **输入框里没有这个开关** —— 该工作区尚未配置提示词（设计如此）；用 `/workspace-prompt` 或设置页先保存一段。 - **点了发送却没有出现确认卡** —— 说明这次发送本来就不需要注入：提示词已经在当前会话上下文里（只有真正要注入时才问），或者该 profile 没有 `userQuestions` 通道（headless / 子代理会话），此时按开关语义直接注入。 - **升级插件后开关点不动 / 只变灰** —— 浏览器里的 client 半是每次刷新从磁盘取的，Host 半只在进程启动时加载：`dsh plugin add` 之后必须**重启 `dsh web`**，否则旧的 Host 会拒绝新字段（插件会直接在开关上提示这一点）。重启后旧的提示词仍保持关闭状态，需要为各工作区重新打开开关。 - **重启后界面里没有插件** —— 用 `dsh --profile web-prompt --dump-config` 确认插件行已被组合进 profile；插件缺失时该行不会出现。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm build # 构建 lib/（提交进仓库，随包发布）；client 样式模块内联进 bundle pnpm test # vitest run ``` `tests/manifest-identity.spec.ts` 断言 `package.json` 的 `name`、`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert[].name` 与 `tsdown.config.ts` 里的 `PLUGIN_ID`（banner 与样式注入共用它）三者一致——改名时它会变红，而不是安静地装上一个加载不起来的包。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 linbin-mk 本包为独立第三方插件，与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系。它不包含任何第三方素材，因此没有 `NOTICE` 文件；构建期与运行期依赖的第三方包各自遵循其自身许可证（运行时依赖以 peer dependency 形式提供，不随本包分发）。
